scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
There are rumors
going around about
the disappearances of
children in the Morocc
area. Some guilds believe
these are actually kidnappings.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
最近摩洛哥地区流传着
关于儿童失踪的传闻。
有些公会认为，
这实际上是绑架案。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Those poor kids...
If I could do something
to help them, by George,
I would do it in a flash.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
那些可怜的孩子...
天哪，如果能帮上忙，
我绝对会立刻行动。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Excuse me? {0}?
Hi there, I've been waiting for
you to wander past me for such
a long time, you know that?
Novices and Super Novices
are so hard to track down...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
请问？{0}？
嗨，你好，我等你路过这里
已经很久了，你知道吗？
寻找初心者和超级初心者
真的很难...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Anyway, I don't know if you
know this, but a lot of kids are missing from Morocc recently.
We're not sure, but we think it's related to the latest assignment
for our Assassin Guild.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
总之，你可能还不知道，
最近摩洛哥有很多孩子失踪。
虽然不确定，但我们认为
这与刺客公会的最新任务有关。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Anyway, the client for this
assignment needs all the help
he can get. Now, I've heard
about you, and I think that
you could be really helpful to
us in this specific situation.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
总之，这个任务的委托人
需要尽可能多的帮助。
我听说过你，我认为
你在这个特定情况下
对我们会有很大的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Look, just do me a favor
and do the right thing like
you always do, okay? Here's
a letter of recommendation
to get you started on this
mission, alright?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
听着，帮个忙，
像往常一样做正确的事，好吗？
这是一封推荐信，
帮你开始这个任务，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, {0}!
Great, I knew you'd
show up sooner or later.
Listen, I'm working here
as a representative of the
Swordman Assocation.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，{0}！
太好了，我就知道你
迟早会出现的。
听着，我作为剑士协会
的代表在这里工作。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, there's something
big going on, and I think it's
the most important thing the
Swordman Association has ever
been involved in. Pack your bags and head to Morocc right now!
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
听着，有一件大事正在发生，
我认为这是剑士协会
成立以来参与过的
最重要的事情。
收拾好行囊，立刻前往摩洛哥！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All the way to Morocc...?
Why, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一直去摩洛哥...？
为什么，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I don't know all the details,
but the Assassin Guild is
working on some missing
children's case, and they've
requested help from us and
all the other guilds...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
我不清楚所有细节，
但刺客公会正在处理
一起儿童失踪案，
他们向我们和其他所有公会
请求了援助...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Rogues, Bards, Novices,
Super Novices, Priests...
You name it. This is gonna be
huge. Listen, if you're going
to help, then let me give you this letter of recommendation...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
流氓、诗人、初心者、
超级初心者、牧师...
你能想到的都有。这会是一场
大行动。听着，如果你打算
帮忙，那就收下这封推荐信...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
{0}...?
I knew you'd show up if
Listen, I have a notice for
you from the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
{0}...？
我就知道你会出现的。
听着，我有一封来自
普隆德拉骑士团的告示
要给你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For me? That sounds
strange, but would you
please read it to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给我的？这听起来
很奇怪，但你能
读给我听吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
''RE: {0}
As leader of the Prontera
Chivalry, I formally request
you to represent the Knights of
Rune-Midgarts in cooperation
with the Assassin Guild.''
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
“主题：{0}
作为普隆德拉骑士团的
首领，我正式请求你
代表卢恩·米德加兹的骑士，
与刺客公会合作。”

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Please assist the Assassin
Guild in any way befitting of
the Knighthood in a special
mission to rescue children
missing from Morocc.
-- Captain Herman''
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
请以符合骑士身份的方式，
协助刺客公会执行一项
特殊任务，营救摩洛哥
失踪的儿童。
—— 船长 赫尔曼”

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
There, that's all it says.
Here, I think you'll need
this letter of recommendation
if you plan to follow these
orders. I hope you take that
mission for those kids' sake...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
好了，上面就是这么写的。
给你，如果你打算执行
这些命令，我想你需要
这封推荐信。我希望你
为了那些孩子接受这个任务...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Excuse me...?
{0}...?
I'm sorry to bother you, but
I've got an urgent communique
for you from Sir Michael Halig
of the Crusaders...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
打扰一下...？
{0}...？
抱歉打扰你，但我有一封
来自十字军骑士
迈克尔·哈利格的紧急通讯
要给你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They usually don't
send messages. I guess
whatever he has to say
must be really important.
What does it say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们通常不会
发消息。我想他说的
一定很重要。
上面写了什么？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Let's see here... Something
about a missing children's case
the Assassin Guild is working on... Ah! The Assassin Guild has
requested help from the Crusaders. So I guess you were recommended.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
让我看看... 关于刺客公会
正在处理的儿童失踪案...
啊！刺客公会向十字军
请求了援助。所以我想你是
被推荐来的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Look, here's the letter of
recommendation that I'm
supposed to give you if you
plan on taking the mission.
For the sake of those missing kids, I really hope that you do.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
听着，这是推荐信，
如果你打算接受任务，
我应该把它给你。
为了那些失踪的孩子，
我真的希望你能接受。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Ah, I forgot to tell you
exactly where you need to
go for the mission details!
Let's see... You're supposed
to... Ah, now I remember~
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
啊，我忘了告诉你
具体该去哪里找任务详情了！
让我想想... 你应该去...
啊，我想起来了~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
If you check out the
west side of the Oasis
inside Morocc, you'll find
a very suspicious looking
hut. Your contact from the
Assassin Guild is near there.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
如果你去摩洛克绿洲西侧看看，
会发现一间看起来很可疑的小屋。
你在刺客公会的联络人就在那附近。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I'm sure you'll find it if
you keep your eyes open.
Anyway, that's all I know.
Why don't you go check it out?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
只要你留心观察，肯定能找到的。
总之，我就知道这些了。
你不妨去那里看看？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Right, for this mission,
you'll need to meet with your
contact from the Assassin
Guild near a hut at the west
side of the Oasis inside Morocc. So keep an eye out for him.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
对了，为了这个任务，
你需要去摩洛克绿洲西侧小屋附近，
与刺客公会的联络人会面。所以请留意他。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I doubt you'll have
trouble finding the guy,
even if all Thieves and
Assassins are starting
to look the same. You
know what I mean, right?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
我觉得你找那个人应该不难，
虽然最近盗贼和刺客
看起来都越来越像了。你知道我意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Are you thinking of taking
the mission? That's great!
Now, you need to meet your
contact from the Assassin
Guild outside a hut on the west side of the Oasis inside Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
你打算接受这个任务吗？太好了！
现在，你需要去摩洛克绿洲西侧小屋外，
与刺客公会的联络人会面。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I know those directions
aren't very clear, but this
is supposedly a top secret
location that's usually only
known to the Assassins...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
我知道这些指示不太明确，
但这据说是个绝密地点，
通常只有刺客们知道...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It looks like you're
working well with the
Assassin Guild. Still,
be careful. There might
be more to this mission
than meets the eye, you know?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
看来你和刺客公会配合得很好。
不过，还是要小心。这个任务
可能没表面看起来那么简单，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It's a nice day, isn't it?
Though, I hope something
exciting happens soon. Peace
is great and all, but I prefer
to have my life shook up
every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
今天天气真好，不是吗？
不过，我希望很快能发生点
刺激的事。和平固然好，
但我更喜欢生活偶尔有点波澜。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Oh, hello there~
Peace be with you,
adventurer. Remember
that no matter how different
people may be, all of us are
united in our humanity.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
哦，你好~
愿平安与你同在，冒险者。
请记住，无论人们之间
有多少差异，我们在人性上
都是紧密相连的。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Ah, hello. Would you ask
anyone that you know
to be affiliated with the
Prontera Church to talk to
me? Acolytes, Priests, Monks...
Any of those would be fine.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
啊，你好。你能否请
你认识的、隶属于普隆德拉
教会的人来找我？服事、牧师、武僧...
任何职位都可以。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
I have something very
important to tell them,
but it's almost impossible
to gather all the clergy
in an emergency situation...
scripts.translation:
[修女]
我有件非常重要的事要告诉他们，
但在紧急情况下，要把所有神职人员
召集起来几乎是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Oh, {0}!
It must be an act of
divine providence that
we finally meet. Actually,
I have something very
important to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
哦，{0}！
我们终于相遇，
这一定是神意的安排。其实，
我有件非常重要的事想拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
You may have heard that
there's been a recent influx
of missing child reports from
Morocc. Apparently, someone
has hired the Assassin Guild
to investigate these cases.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
你可能听说过，最近摩洛克
接二连三地发生儿童失踪案。
显然，有人雇佣了刺客公会
来调查这些案件。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Since this is such a huge
issue, the Assassin Guild has
even gone so far as to request
the Prontera Church for help, so I'd like you to aid the Assassin
Guild in this mission.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
鉴于此事影响重大，刺客公会
甚至向普隆德拉教会请求了援助，
所以我希望你能协助刺客公会
完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
However, I believe that
the Assassin Guild's client
may have other intentions,
so I also want you to keep
an eye out and see if their
client can be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
不过，我认为刺客公会的委托人
可能另有图谋，
所以我也希望你多加留意，
看看他们的委托人是否值得信任。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Please visit Morocc
as soon as you can.
When you arrive, you
will need the Bishop's
letter of recommendation,
so please take it now.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
请尽快前往摩洛克。
到达后，你需要主教的推荐信，
所以请现在收下它。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Now, for this mission, you
will need to meet your contact
from the Assassin Guild near
a hut on the west side of the
Oasis inside Morocc. I wonder
why they chose that location?
scripts.translation:
[修女]
现在，为了这个任务，
你需要去摩洛克绿洲西侧小屋附近，
与刺客公会的联络人会面。我很好奇
他们为什么选在那里？

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Normally, a representative
of the Prontera Church would
simply visit the Assassin Guild itself. Be careful. The Assassins
must be being extra secret because of extraordinary circumstances...
scripts.translation:
[修女]
通常，普隆德拉教会的代表

help in a mission regarding

from Morocc recently. Here, take this letter of recommendation...

协助一项关于摩洛克近期
儿童失踪的任务。给你，拿着这封推荐信...

scripts.text:

If the Assassin Guild

no doubt that this will be
a very difficult mission.
You should prepare yourself
if you plan to get involved...
scripts.translation:

我毫不怀疑这将是一项
非常艰难的任务。
如果你打算参与，
最好做好充分的准备...

嘿，{0}？
我有一封来自炼金术士公会的
消息要给你。嗯，与其说是消息，
不如说是命令。我真幸运能遇到你。

scripts.text:

The Assassin Guild has
officially asked our guild
for help in a mission regarding
children that have been missing
from Morocc, and they want us
to send somebody... you!
scripts.translation:

协助一项关于摩洛克近期

派个人去...就是你！

scripts.text:

one of the people that the
Alchemist Guild wants to send
to represent us. So why don't
you go? You know, do it for the
children. Just think about it.
scripts.translation:

或者...至少，你是炼金术士公会想要派去代表我们的人之一。所以为什么不去呢？你知道的，为了那些孩子。好好考虑一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Here, take this letter of
recommendation with you and
head over to Morocc as soon
as you can. If even the Assassin Guild needs help, I'm sure that
spells really big trouble...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
拿着，带上这封推荐信，尽快前往摩洛克。如果连刺客公会都需要帮助，那肯定是大麻烦...

scripts.text:

Geffen Tower Dungeon?
If you run into any magic
users, would please tell
them to come and see me?
scripts.translation:

你是要去吉芬塔地牢吗？
如果你遇到任何使用魔法的人，请告诉他们来见我。

scripts.text:

It's difficult to gather
the members of the magic
community, and I have an
urgent message for Mages,
Wizards and Sages to hear...
scripts.translation:

很难召集魔法社区的成员，我有一条紧急消息需要传达给魔法师、巫师和贤者...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
Whoa, would you wait
a minute? Actually, you
might be just right for
this special mission...
scripts.translation:
[学院职员]
哎呀，请等一下。
其实，你也许正适合
这项特殊任务...

scripts.text:

The Assassin Guild has
sent a formal request to the
Mage and Wizard Guilds, and
the Schweicherbil Academy for
aid in completing a mission
involving missing children...
scripts.translation:

刺客公会向魔法师公会、
巫师公会以及施韦希比尔学院
发出了正式请求，
寻求协助完成一项
涉及失踪儿童的任务...

scripts.text:

{0}...

the magic community by
assisting the Assassins
in this mission. Please take
this letter of recommendation.
scripts.translation:

{0}...
我希望你能代表魔法界，
协助刺客公会完成这项任务。
请收下这封推荐信。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
If you choose to assist
the Assassin Guild on our
behalf, please let me know
so I can tell you where
you can meet your contact.
I shall be waiting here...
scripts.translation:

如果你决定代表我们
协助刺客公会，请告诉我，
我会告诉你联络人的地点。
我会在这里等待...

scripts.text:

Have you decided to help
the Assassin Guild? Then
please, head to Morocc and
meet your contact that will
be waiting for you west of
the Oasis inside of the city.
scripts.translation:

你决定协助刺客公会了吗？
那么，请前往摩洛克，
在城市内的绿洲西侧
与等待你的联络人见面。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
The Assassins don't ask
for help very often, so I'm
sure that this must be a very
serious matter. Be careful
and bring pride to the magic
community. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[学院职员]
刺客公会很少请求帮助，
所以这肯定是一件非常
严重的事情。请小心行事，
为魔法界争光。祝你好运...

scripts.text:

I've heard that the
Assassins are very
impressed with your use
of magic. Cooperate with
them to finish the mission,
and remember to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[学院职员]
我听说刺客公会对你
运用魔法的能力印象深刻。
请与他们合作完成任务，
并务必注意安全。

scripts.text:

The weather is certainly
pleasant right now, but the
worst storms come when the
winds are at their calmest.
Verily, the peacefulness
in the air disturbs me...
scripts.translation:

现在的天气确实不错，
但最猛烈的风暴往往
出现在风平浪静之时。
说实话，空气中弥漫的
宁静让我感到不安...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey little kid...
What are you doing
hanging around here?
You know children like
you have been missing
from this city, right?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，小孩子...
你在这里闲逛什么？
你知道最近城里
有很多像你这样的
孩子失踪了吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You had better leave
and play someplace safer,
like Prontera or Alberta.
Run along now and stay
away from strangers, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你最好离开这里，
去普隆德拉或艾尔贝塔
等更安全的地方玩。
快走吧，别和陌生人
搭话，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...............................
Huh? What the hell
do you want? Buzz off
and don't talk to me,
unless you want a fat lip!

[Miya]
Wait! Wait up! You're
a Taekwon Master, right?
Remember Moohyun? He
helped you job change...?
He wrote this letter for you.
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
等等！等等！
你是跆拳大师，对吧？
还记得武铉吗？
他帮你更换了职业...
他写了这封信给你。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Listen, {0}...
He's asking you to help
the Assassin Guild on a
special mission. I think
it's pretty serious business.
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
听着，{0}...
他请求你协助刺客公会
完成一项特殊任务。
我觉得这挺严重的。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
If you're interested in
assisting the Assassins,
then meet with your contact to
the west, somewhere around
here in this city. Well, that's
all he told me, so I'll seeya~
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
如果你有兴趣协助刺客，
就在这个城市的西边
某个地方与联络人见面。
嗯，他就告诉了我这些，
那我先走了~

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Hey, {0},
I've got some important
work for you. The Assassin
Guild actually asked the Thief
and Rogue Guilds for help!
Can you believe that?
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
嘿，{0}，
我有件重要的事找你。
刺客公会竟然向盗贼公会
和流氓公会求助了！
你能相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Anyway, all of us ruffians
are supposed to help out if
we can. Here, take this letter
of recommendation and talk to
Jack, our contact west in this city. You better go right away...
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
总之，我们这些流氓
能帮就尽量帮。拿着，
这是推荐信，去见见我们
在西边的联络人杰克吧。
你最好马上出发...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
{0}!
The Assassin Guild Master
wants you right away. Do you
know where the secret pub is?
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
{0}！
刺客公会的会长
想立刻见你。
你知道那个秘密酒吧在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, h-hi, Miya,
it's been a while.
What secret pub?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，嗨，米娅，
好久不见。
什么秘密酒吧？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
I figured you might not
have heard of it. Just talk
to Jack, west of the Oasis
in this city, and he'll let you
in. From now on, you'll be
spending plenty of time there.
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
我想你可能没听说过。
去见见绿洲西边的杰克，
他会让你进去的。
从现在开始，你会经常
去那里的。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
That pub is probably the
only place where Assassins
like us can relax. But yeah,
this mission is pretty major.
We'll need all the help that
we can possibly get...
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
那个酒吧大概是唯一
能让像我们这样的刺客
放松的地方。不过，
这次任务确实很大。
我们需要尽可能多的帮助...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
If you're interested in
assisting the Assassins,
then meet with your contact to
the west, somewhere around
here in this city. Well, that's
all he told me, so I'll seeya~
scripts.translation:

就在这个城市的西边
某个地方与联络人见面。
嗯，他就告诉了我这些，
那我先走了~

scripts.text:
[Miya]
There's supposed to be
some private pub to the
west of the Oasis in this
city. Ah, you're supposed
to talk to our contact, Jack,
who's right outside of the pub.
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
据说这座城市的绿洲西边
有一家私人酒吧。
啊，你要去见我们的联络人杰克，
他就站在酒吧外面。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Look west of the Oasis
here in Morocc to find Jack,
who will let you go inside the
pub. Our guildmaster will be
waiting for you inside...
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
在摩洛克绿洲的西边
找到杰克，他会让你
进入酒吧的。
我们的公会会长会在里面等你...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
So how's it been going?
I think the assignment you're
working on must be pretty
important. I mean, if it's
giving Kidd and Lin trouble...
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
最近过得怎么样？
我想你正在执行的任务
一定很重要。
毕竟，如果连基德和琳
都感到棘手的话...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
How's your current
assignment coming along?
The guildmaster must have
given you something really
weird or almost impossible
to do again, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
你现在的任务进展如何？
公会会长肯定又给你
派了个奇怪或者几乎
不可能完成的任务，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
It's been way too
quiet lately. I really
hope that something crazy
happens soon. Otherwise,
I think I'll die of boredom!
scripts.translation:
[米娅]
最近实在太安静了。
我真希望快点发生
什么疯狂的事情。
不然，我觉得我会
无聊死的！

planning to travel through
Morocc. Recently, there have
been reports of missing
children there...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
如果你打算穿越摩洛克，
请务必小心。最近那里

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Excuse me, but if you happen
to encounter any bowmen, or
people with any archery skill,
would you ask them to come to
me? I have an urgent message
that I should tell them.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
打扰一下，如果你遇到
任何弓箭手，或者
拥有射箭技能的人，
能请你让他们来找我吗？
我有紧急消息要传达给他们。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Ah... Finally!
Another practitioner
of Taekwon Do! You're...
Let's see... You must
be {0}, yes?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
啊...终于！
又一位跆拳道的修行者！
你是...
让我看看...你一定是{0}，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Mr. Phoenix has charged
me with the task of notifying
all Taekwon Do practitioners
of the request sent to us by
the Assassin Guild. Apparently,
they need aid for a mission...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
凤凰先生委托我
通知所有跆拳道修行者
刺客公会发来的请求。
看来，他们需要协助执行一项任务...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
If you are interested in
assisting them, please take
this Letter of Recommendation
and bring it to the contact from the Assassin Guild in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
如果你有兴趣协助他们，
请带上这封推荐信，
去摩洛克绿洲西边的
刺客公会联络人那里。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You can meet the
Assassin Guildsman near
some hut on the west side
of the Oasis inside Morocc.
Good luck, my friend, and please represent Taekwon Do with pride.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
你可以在摩洛克绿洲西边
的一个小屋附近
见到刺客公会成员。
祝你好运，我的朋友，
请为跆拳道感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
{0}...?

have finally found you!

for you from the Icarus Guild.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
{0}...？

听着，我有来自
伊卡洛斯公会的消息给你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It looks like the Assassin
Guild has formally asked them
for help in some mission, so
Icarus has decided to send you.
I hope you choose to represent
us and help those Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
看起来刺客公会
正式请求他们协助
某项任务，所以伊卡洛斯
决定派你去。
我希望你能代表我们，
去帮助那些刺客。

scripts.text:

哦，你连买水的Zeny都不够。天哪...
如果你真的想进来，
确保你带够了钱！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Not the savvy type,
are you...? Fine, fine.
If you're not gonna do
me any favors, then why
should I help you? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
看来你不是很机灵啊...？
好吧，好吧。
如果你不打算帮我个忙，
我为什么要帮你？走开！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Not at all.
Make sure that this
one isn't allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
完全不行。
确保不让这个人
进入。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
You heard the man.
You better retreat
from this place while
you still have legs...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你听到师父的话了。
趁你还有腿，
最好赶紧离开这里...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What's the matter?
Oh, I see... You're
probably wondering why
a Knight like me is in a
secret Assassin's pub.
What about you, huh?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
怎么了？
哦，我明白了...你大概在想，
像我这样的骑士为什么会出现在
刺客的秘密酒吧里。
你呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What's the matter?
Oh, I see... You're
probably wondering why
a Knight like me is in a
secret Assassin's pub.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
怎么了？
哦，我明白了...你大概在想，
像我这样的骑士为什么会出现在
刺客的秘密酒吧里。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
It just so happens that
I'm really old friends with
the owner of the pub. I do
favors for him, and he does
favors for me. That's how
we do it around here.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
碰巧我和酒吧老板
是老朋友。我帮他忙，
他也帮我忙。这就是我们
在这里的相处方式。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome to my
little pub. What
will you be having?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
欢迎来到我的小酒馆。
想喝点什么？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Huh. How did
a ruffian like you
get in here? Well, if
Jack let you in, I guess
you must be alright. So
what do you wanna drink?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嗯？像你这种粗人是怎么进来的？
既然杰克让你进来了，
想必也没问题吧。
那么，想喝点什么？

scripts.text:
[Master]
This place is supposed
to be Assassins only, but
I guess I'll make an exception
for you. Hell, you must have
had a rough time just getting
in. So what are you drinking?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这里本来是只接待刺客的，
不过我就破例一次吧。
天哪，你能进来肯定也不容易。
那么，想喝点什么？

scripts.text: Order a Drink
scripts.translation: 点一杯饮料

scripts.text: Ask about Mission
scripts.translation: 询问任务

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master]
In this place, I only
serve two drinks. You
want a Tropical Sograt or
a Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这里只供应两种饮料。
你要热带的苏克拉特，
还是赤色海滩？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: Do you have anything cheaper?
scripts.translation: 有没有便宜点的？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, why did you bring
so much stuff with you?
I can't give you anything
to drink if you don't have
the room to carry it around.
Clear out your inventory!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嘿，你带这么多东西来干什么？
如果你没有空间携带，
我就没法给你倒饮料了。
清空你的物品栏！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You know...
I was going to charge you
800 zeny for this drink, but
it looks like you can't afford
it right now. Come back when
you have the zeny, alright?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你知道吗...
这杯饮料本来要收你800 Zeny，
但看来你现在付不起。
等你有钱了再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Most bartenders would
usually charge 1,000 zeny
for this stuff, but I'll only
ask you for 800. Enjoy it,
my friend, and drink it as
deeply as you would life.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
大多数调酒师卖这种酒都要1,000 Zeny，
但我只要800。
好好享受吧，我的朋友，
像品味生命一样细细品尝。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, you don't have
the zeny for this drink.
Make sure you come back
with 1,000 zeny if you want
me to fix you something, okay?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嘿，你没有足够的Zeny买这杯饮料。
如果你想让我给你调一杯，
记得带1,000 Zeny回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
For Assassins, I charge
800 zeny, but for you, I'm
gonna charge 1,000. No
hard feelings, but you're
already lucky to be here.
Hey, enjoy your drink~
scripts.translation:
[师父]
对刺客，我收800 Zeny，
但对你，我要收1,000。
别介意，你能在这里已经很幸运了。
嘿，好好享受你的饮料~

scripts.text:
[Master]
What are you...?
I just told you
I only serve two
drinks. If you want
water, you oughtta
go someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你要什么...？
我刚说过，我只供应两种饮料。
如果你想喝水，
最好去别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ah, you must be here on
the orders of the guildmaster.
Alright, just go inside. Hey,
but be careful. This won't be
easy like most assignments...
scripts.translation:
[师父]
啊，你是公会会长派来的吧。
好的，进去吧。嘿，
不过要小心。这不像大多数任务那样简单...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Mission...?
Come on, what are
you talking about?
Stop talking crazy and
order something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
任务...？
拜托，你在说什么？
别胡言乱语了，
点杯饮料吧。

scripts.text: Show Letter of Recommendation
scripts.translation: 出示推荐信

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ah, I see you that you
came prepared. Sorry about
that, but we've got protocols
about secrecy that I'm sworn
to upkeep. Alright, do see that
Knight over there? Litheron!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
啊，看来你准备得很充分。
抱歉，
但我有保密的规矩必须遵守。
好的，看到那边那个骑士了吗？利瑟隆！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey Litheron! Let this
guy go through, willya?
Yeah, just talk to Litheron,
and he'll show you where to go.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嘿，利瑟隆！
让这家伙过去，行吗？
对，就跟利瑟隆说话，
他会告诉你该去哪里。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, since when did
I become your doorman?!
Eh, ah well. You got it.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，我什么时候变成你的门卫了？！
呃，算了。你赢了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou forgot to bring your
Letter of Recommendation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你忘记带推荐信了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright...
You're looking way
too suspicious now.
Maybe I'm wrong, but
I don't like taking chances.
Boys, show this guy the door!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
好吧...
你现在看起来太可疑了。
也许我想多了，
但我讨厌冒险。
伙计们，把这个家伙赶出去！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Just go through the
door behind Litheron.
You know the drill, so
hurry it up, willya?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
就从利瑟隆身后的门进去。
你知道规矩，
快点，行吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go through the door
behind Litheron if you
wanna learn more about
your secret mission.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
如果你想了解更多关于你的秘密任务，
就从利瑟隆身后的门进去。

scripts.text:
[Master]
How's your assignment
coming along? Sometimes,
you need to relax and take a
break. When that time comes,
I'll have a drink ready for you.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
任务进展如何？
有时候，你需要放松一下，休息一下。
到时候，我会为你准备好一杯酒。

scripts.text:
[Master]
How are you doing
with the mission? It's
good to see you getting
along with the Assasssins.
Anyway, best of luck, pal.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
任务做得怎么样？
很高兴看到你和刺客们相处融洽。
总之，祝你好运，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, thanks for all
of your hard work, pal.
I'll see you around.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嘿，谢谢你这么辛苦的工作，伙计。
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thanks for all of your
help, even if you did go
through a little more trouble
than you should have. Anyway,
you seem alright, so go ahead and come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
谢谢你的帮助，
虽然你确实遇到了比预期更多的麻烦。
总之，你看起来没事，
想什么时候回来都可以。

scripts.text:
[Master]
So you haven't been
assigned any missions
from this joint, eh? By the
way, you like this place?
I happen to really love
this little pub of mine.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
所以，你还没有从这地方接到任何任务，是吗？
顺便问一下，你喜欢这里吗？
我真的很喜欢我的小酒馆。

scripts.text:
[Master]
If you want, I'll recommend
you to the guildmaster for
a mission. Until then, you've
got to focus on your training.
And until you train... Why
don't you enjoy a drink?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
如果你愿意，我会向公会会长推荐你接任务。
在那之前，你必须专注于训练。
在训练之前... 为什么不来喝一杯呢？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Mission...?
Come on, what are
you talking about?
Stop talking crazy and
order something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
任务...？
拜托，你在说什么？
别胡言乱语了，
点杯饮料吧。

scripts.text:
[Master]
...

[Tao]
Meow, what the hell
happened to you? Kidd
brought you in here, all
beat up and asked me to
take care of you till you woke
up. Are you alright, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
喵，你到底怎么了？基德把你带进来，
你浑身是伤，让我照顾你直到你醒来。
你没事吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Oh yes, as soon as you
feel better, Kidd wants you
to go to the commanding
officer's room that's over
to the left, meow. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
哦对了，等你感觉好些了，
基德让你去左边的军官室，喵。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Mm...?
What do you
need, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
嗯...？
你需要什么，喵？

scripts.text: Ask about Mission
scripts.translation: 询问任务

scripts.text: M-meow?
scripts.translation: 喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The mission...?
Just enter the room
to the left. You can tell
left from right, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
任务...？
直接进左边的房间就行。
你能分清左右吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Good luck, meow.
Tao keeps this place
safe from people that
don't belong here, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
祝你好运，喵。
陶会保护这里，不让不属于这里的人进来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Meow, meow.
It's a long story, meow.
Something about wanting
a Big Ribbon and hunting
Wild Roses, meow. It all started when meow, meow, meow, meow...
scripts.translation:
[陶]
喵，喵。
说来话长，喵。
好像是为了想要红蝶发带，
还有狩猎狂暴野猫，喵。
一切开始于喵，喵，喵，喵...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那个地方有魔法保护，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分钟^000000的时间待在那里。
别浪费时间，喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Sooo sorry, meow~
Someone else is already
inside. Just come back
again later, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
真...真抱歉，喵~
里面已经有人了。
请稍后再来，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Wh-who are you?
This is a restricted
area, meow! If you don't
have permission, then get
out of there right meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你...你是谁？
这里是禁区，喵！
如果没有许可，
请立刻出去，喵！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't go back to
Lin yet... I still need
to fully investigate
Thanatos Tower...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在还不能回去找琳...
我还需要彻底调查达纳托斯塔...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那个地方有魔法保护，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分钟^000000的时间待在那里。
别浪费时间，喵！

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

[{0}]
Hey, R! It's me!
Would you please
open the door?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，R！是我！
请帮我开下门好吗？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I-I'm sorry, but now's
not a good time. Come
back here later, please!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
对...对不起，现在不是时候。
请稍后再来，拜托了！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is a restricted area,
so if you don't have any
permission, then get out
of here, right meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这里是禁区，
如果没有许可，
请立刻出去，喵！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Welcome. Ah, this must be
your first assignment here.
I'm the commanding officer
of these missions, so please
listen to me very closely.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
欢迎。啊，这应该是你第一次执行这里的任务。
我是这些任务的指挥官，
请仔细听我说。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The Assassin Guild agreed to
perform two missions that are
supposed to be related to the
missing children in Morocc.
You must choose one mission
in which you will participate.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
刺客公会同意执行两项任务，
这两项任务应该与莫洛克的失踪儿童有关。
你必须选择其中一项任务参与。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Good, good, I've been
waiting for you. Since our
time is limited, I'll be brief.
I'm the commanding officer
for these two missions that the Assassin Guild has agreed to take.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
很好，很好，我一直在等你。
由于时间有限，我就长话短说了。
我是刺客公会同意接下的这两项任务的指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Due to the nature of these
missions and their objectives,
we have decided to recruit help
from outside. We recognize that
Assassins may not be suited
for some of the objectives...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
鉴于这些任务的性质和目标，
我们决定招募外部援助。
我们承认，刺客可能并不适合某些目标...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The client for the first
mission is the Dandelion
organization. If you accept,
then you will work under Kidd
and both of you will search and
pursue a specified target.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
第一个任务的委托方是蒲公英组织。
如果你接受，
你将在基德的指挥下工作，
你们两人将搜索并追捕指定目标。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The client for the other
mission is an academic that
has identified himself as ''R.'' His credentials check out,
and it seems that all he has
requested special protection.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
另一个任务的委托方是一位自称“R.”的学者。
他的身份核实无误，
看起来他只是要求提供特别保护。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I'll be honest: both of our
clients strike me as suspicious, but if working with them brings
us closer to helping those lost
children, we've got to take that chance. I hope you understand.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
说实话：我们的两个委托方都让我觉得可疑，
但如果与他们合作能让我们更接近帮助那些失踪儿童，
我们就必须抓住这个机会。希望你能理解。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Will you work as a hunter for the Dandelion organization, or will
you work as Mr. R's bodyguard?
Please choose the client whose
job best suits your skills and
abilities before anything else.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你是想作为蒲公英组织的猎人，
还是想作为R.先生的保镖？
请在其他一切之前，
选择最适合你技能和能力的委托方。

scripts.text: Dandelion Organization
scripts.translation: 蒲公英组织

scripts.text: Mr. R
scripts.translation: R.先生

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
So you're choosing to
work for the Dandelion
organization? In that case, Kidd is your immediate superior.
I trust the two of you will work well together to finish this.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
所以你选择为蒲公英组织工作？
在这种情况下，基德是你的直接上级。
我相信你们两人会合作愉快，完成这项任务。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey there~
I'm Kidd.
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗨~
我是基德。
很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, please take this
written request and meet
the Dandelion representative
in the pub. He'll brief you
further on your mission.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
好的，请拿着这份书面请求，
去酒吧找蒲公英组织的代表。
他会进一步向你简报任务详情。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well then, Lin, I will
assign you to bodyguard
duty over Mr. R. Make sure
to keep a close eye on him.
That is all. Dismissed!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
那么，琳，
我将指派你担任R.先生的保镖。
务必时刻密切关注他。
就这样，解散！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright. Lin will be
your immediate superior
in this mission. You'll be
working with her to ensure
that no harm befalls Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
好的。琳将是
你在这次任务中的直接上级。
你要与她合作，
确保R.先生毫发无伤。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Heya, I'm Lin.
I'm lookin' forward
to working together
with you. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗨，我是琳。
很期待与你的合作。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Here, take this written
request to Mr. R who will
be waiting in the next room.
This document will prove to
him that you have been assigned
as his personal bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
拿着，把这份书面请求
交给在下一间房间等候的R.先生。
这份文件将向他证明，
你已被指派为他的贴身保镖。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
We're running out of
time. Hurry and meet the
Dandelion representative
in the pub so that you can
proceed with the mission.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
时间不多了。
快去酒吧见蒲公英组织的代表，
以便继续执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Please meet with the
representative from
Dandelion in the pub as
soon as possible. We can't
afford to waste time when
children's lives are at stake.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
请尽快去酒吧
与蒲公英组织的代表会面。
当孩子们的生命受到威胁时，
我们可没有时间浪费。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Your first priority is
to speak to Kidd, your
immediate superior in the
mission that you've accepted.
I trust that your work will please the Dandelion organization.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你的首要任务是
与你所接受任务的直接上级基德对话。
我相信你的工作会让蒲公英组织满意。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Your first priority is
to speak to Lin, your
immediate superior in the
mission that you've accepted.
Please do your best to protect Mr. R. as his personal bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你的首要任务是
与你所接受任务的直接上级琳对话。
请尽你所能，作为贴身保镖保护R.先生。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
So how do you feel?
Although this mission
is technically a failure,
we shouldn't feel too bad.
Considering all the unknowns,
we did surprisingly well.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
感觉如何？
虽然这次任务在技术上算是失败，
但我们不必太难过。
考虑到那么多未知因素，
我们的表现已经相当不错了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait; a minute...
Are you saying we stopped
Satan Morocc's revival, but
Raiyan Moore escaped?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等...等一下...
你是说我们阻止了魔王梦罗克的复活，
但莱恩·摩尔逃走了？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah...
That snake managed
to get away in all of
that confusion.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是啊...
那条蛇在那片混乱中
溜走了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Not only did he play
me for a fool, but he
escaped right before
my eyes! Don't bother
chasing him... I'll be
the one who turns him in!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
他不仅把我耍得团团转，
还在我眼前逃走了！
别去追他...我会亲自把他交出去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Lin, I understand how
you must feel, but don't
be so hard on yourself.
Lin, you did your job
perfectly, and there's no
way we could have known...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳，我理解你的感受，
但别太自责了。
琳，你完美地完成了你的工作，
而且我们根本不可能预见到...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Although I agree with Kidd,
I will entrust with the task
of bringing back Raiyan, Lin,
if that's what you really want.
Everyone else must feel very exhausted, so let's take a break.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
虽然我同意基德的话，
但如果你真的这么想，
我就把追回莱恩的任务交给你，琳。
大家都应该很累了，我们休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
...I'm sorry, Valdes,
but I don't want to lose
Moore's trail. I'd better
go now while I can...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
...对不起，瓦尔德斯，
我不想失去摩尔的踪迹。
我最好趁现在赶紧去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems upset....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她看起来很沮丧....

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, as a fellow Assassin,
I'm sure you can understand
what's she going through.
We have too much pride to
take this kind of failure lightly.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嗯，作为同行刺客，
我相信你能理解她的心情。
我们太有自尊了，
无法轻视这种失败。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, she's an Assassin.
All of us have too much pride
to accept any kind of failure.
It's just... It's just not in
our vocabulary, you see?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嗯，她是刺客。
我们都有太强的自尊心，
无法接受任何形式的失败。
只是...只是这个词
不在我们的词汇表里，你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
We failed our original
objective to save those kids,
but we did stop Satan Morocc.
You did a good job, and we'll
notify your guild of your good
work. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我们未能达成拯救那些孩子的最初目标，
但我们确实阻止了魔王梦罗克。
你做得很好，我们会通知你的公会
表扬你的出色表现。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Regardless of our
original objective,
I must say that you
did a good job. We
didn't save the children,
but we stopped Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
尽管我们最初的
目标未能达成，
但我必须说，
你做得很好。我们
没能救下那些孩子，
但我们阻止了魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Take care of yourself,
and take pride in the fact
that the Assassin Guild
considers you a valuable
ally. Be safe, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
请保重，
并为此感到自豪：
刺客公会
视你为宝贵的盟友。
一路平安，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd, when you're
ready, I have another
assignment for you in
Prontera. But for now,
I want you to take it easy.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
基德，当你
准备好的时候，
我在普隆德拉
还有另一个任务
交给你。但现在，
我想让你休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Heh. Alright,
Valdes. I guess
my work is never
finished~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呵。好吧，
瓦尔德斯。看来
我的工作是
做不完的~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
How are you feeling?
I've got some bad news:
All of us, every member of
the Assassin Guild... We
were tricked by Raiyan Moore...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你感觉怎么样？
我有个坏消息：
我们所有人，刺客公会的
每一位成员...我们
都被莱恩·摩尔耍了...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
How are you feeling?
I've got some bad news:
these missions we were
assigned... They were all
part of an elaborate scheme
that all of us fell for...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你感觉怎么样？
我有个坏消息：
我们接到的这些任务...
它们都是
一个精心策划的阴谋的一部分，
我们都上当了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
We were fooled by that
damned bastard. Everything
that Raiyan Moore wanted us
to do was for the sake of
Satan Morocc's reincarnation.
He almost got away with it...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我们被那个
该死的混蛋骗了。
莱恩·摩尔让我们
做的一切，都是为了
魔王梦罗克的转世。
他差点就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
He got away from us
this time... I'm sorry.
I should have caught him,
but he had help. I failed you.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
这次他
逃掉了...对不起。
我应该抓住他的，
但他有人帮忙。我让你失望了。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Lin, you don't gotta
apologize. There's no
way you could've known.
C'mon, we understand
how you feel, but it's not
your fault at all.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳，你不用
道歉。你不可能
知道那些事。
来吧，我们理解
你的感受，但这完全
不是你的错。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd is right. We shouldn't
be blaming ourselves or 
each other. For now, we can
be satisfied with preventing
Satan Morocc's revival, and
then focus on Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
基德说得对。我们不应该
责怪自己或
彼此。目前，我们可以
满足于阻止了
魔王梦罗克的复活，
然后集中精力对付莱恩·摩尔。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Don't worry, Valdes.
I'm going to take care of
Raiyan Moore. He's not going
to get away from me again.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
别担心，瓦尔德斯。
我会处理
莱恩·摩尔的。他不会再
从我手中逃脱了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, Lin...
Although I'd prefer for
you to rest for now, I can
respect your conviction.
Alright, I'll entrust you with
the task of finding Moore.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嗯，琳...
虽然我更希望
你现在休息，但我
尊重你的决心。
好吧，我将把
寻找摩尔的任务交给你。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Ah, and before I forget,
let me give you your fee
for taking this mission.
We may have technically
failed our original objective,
but you did very good work.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
啊，在我忘记之前，
让我支付你
接受这个任务的报酬。
虽然我们在技术上
未能达成最初的目标，
但你做得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Ah, and before I forget,
let me give you your fee
for taking this mission.
I thank you on behalf of
the Assassin Guild for
your efforts and hard work.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
啊，在我忘记之前，
让我支付你
接受这个任务的报酬。
我谨代表刺客公会
感谢你的努力和辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Technically, we failed to
achieve our original mission
objective, but I will notify your guild and tell them that you were
instrumental in preventing
a worldwide catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
从技术上讲，我们未能
达成最初的任务目标，
但我会通知你的公会，
告诉他们你在
阻止全球性灾难中
发挥了关键作用。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Valdes...
I'm leaving now.
Wish me luck, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
瓦尔德斯...
我现在要走了。
祝我好运，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, then.
You're dismissed.
I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
好的，那么。
你可以离开了。
下次见。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, then.
You're dismissed.
Once again, thank you
for helping us. You've
been a valuable ally to the
Assassin Guild, so be proud.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
好的，那么。
你可以离开了。
再次感谢
你的帮助。你一直是
刺客公会宝贵的盟友，
请为此感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd, when you're
ready, I have another
assignment for you in
Prontera. But for now,
I want you to take it easy.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
基德，当你
准备好的时候，
我在普隆德拉
还有另一个任务
交给你。但现在，
我想让你休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Heh. Alright,
Valdes. I guess
my work is never
finished~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呵。好吧，
瓦尔德斯。看来
我的工作是
做不完的~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You may go ahead
and take a rest. The
last mission you took
was so critical, you
can afford to take
a short vacation.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你可以
去休息一下了。
你接手的最后一个任务
非常关键，
你可以
享受一个短暂的假期。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You've been of great
help to the Assassin
Guild. Your aid will
always be welcome here.
If it weren't for you, then
Satan Morocc would have...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你对刺客公会
帮助很大。
这里永远欢迎你的援助。
如果不是你，魔王梦罗克就会...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hmm... If you're here
for the reason that I think
you're here, you should talk
to our boss Valdes first.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯...如果你来这里
是为了我认为的那个原因，
你应该先去找我们的老板瓦尔德斯。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey. You're working
with Kidd, right? He's
right over there. Anyway,
don't worry, he's pretty
easy to get along with.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿。你是在
和基德一起工作，对吧？
他就在那边。总之，
别担心，他很好相处的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
First things first.
We need to talk to our
client, R, over in the next
room. I'll meet you there.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
首先。
我们需要去隔壁房间
见见我们的委托人R。
我在那里等你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFLin seems extremely
exhausted and depressed.
For now, let's go talk to Valdes, the commanding officer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳看起来
极度疲惫和沮丧。
现在，让我们去找指挥官瓦尔德斯谈谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
H-hey...
I hear that
Kidd saved you.
...............................
Sorry, {0}...
I l-let you down...

^3355FFLin seems extremely
exhausted and depressed.
For now, let's go talk to Valdes, the commanding officer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳看起来
极度疲惫和沮丧。
现在，让我们去找指挥官瓦尔德斯谈谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
I thought we're
only supposed to
protect you? What
exactly is going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什么...？
我以为我们
只是负责保护你？
到底发生了什么事？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I'm sorry, but it is
imperative that I leave
for the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
很抱歉，但我必须
立刻前往朱诺图书馆...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
talking about...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，
你们在说什么...？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，这位是{0}，
是我这次任务的搭档。
别担心，你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust her.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，这位是{0}，
是我这次任务的搭档。
别担心，你可以信任她。

scripts.text:
[R.]
Ah, I see. Please,
for the sake of anonymity,
call me Mr. R. If it will help
you in your task, you may want
to ask Lin to explain everything that I just told her. Excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
啊，我明白了。请，
为了匿名起见，
请叫我R先生。如果这有助于
你们完成任务，你们可以
让琳解释一下我刚才告诉她的事情。失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生从项链上
取下一个吊坠，
放在额头上，
然后快速低声念了几句，
接着抬起头。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What was that?
Mr. R just took out
that strange pendant
and starting praying
or... something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
那是什么？
R先生刚拿出
那个奇怪的吊坠，
就开始祈祷
或者...什么。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I guess he was praying...
Though whatever religion
it is, I've never heard of it.
Anyway, it's not a big deal.
Let me explain our current
objective for this assignment.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想他是在祈祷...
虽然不管是什么宗教，
我都没听说过。总之，
这不是什么大事。
让我解释一下我们这次
任务的目标。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Our client, Mr. R, was attacked
while researching important
documents in the Juno Library.
He escaped with his life, but
he wasn't able to bring all of
the documents along with him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我们的委托人R先生，
在朱诺图书馆研究重要
文件时遭到了袭击。
他保住了性命，但
没能把所有文件都带出来。

scripts.text:
[R.]
The information in those
documents is vital for my
research, and may provide
clues to finding those children
that have been missing from
Morocc. Please retrieve them!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
那些文件中的信息
对我的研究至关重要，
并且可能提供线索，
找到那些从梦罗克失踪的
孩子们。请取回它们！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, I guess that's that.
I suppose that if we retrieve
those documents, we'll be one
step closer to finding those
lost kids. So let's do this.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯，我想就是这样。
我想如果我们取回
那些文件，我们就会
离找到那些失踪的孩子
更近一步。所以让我们开始吧。

scripts.text: Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text: Won't they attack again?
scripts.translation: 他们不会再次袭击吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait! It's too risky!
What if Mr. R is attacked
again? I mean, isn't that
why we're here? To protect
him from those attackers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！太危险了！
万一R先生再次遭到袭击怎么办？
我们不是在这里保护他免受袭击者伤害的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Good point. I guess
we should split up.
One of us will stay here
to guard Mr. R, and the other
will go to the Juno Library to
find his research documents.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
有道理。我想我们应该分头行动。
一个人留在这里保护R先生，
另一个人去朱诺图书馆
寻找他的研究文件。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Won't they attack
again? Shouldn't both
of us guard Mr. R here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们不会再次袭击吧？
难道不应该我们两个都留在这里保护R先生吗？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I agree with you, but
I think one of us should
be enough to ensure Mr. R's
safety. Besides, we should be
doing all that we can to save
those missing children.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我同意你的看法，
但我觉得我们其中一个人
应该足以确保R先生的安全。
况且，我们应该尽一切可能
去拯救那些失踪的孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think you're right.
But I think we should
see if that's alright
with Mr. R first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得你说得对。
但我想我们应该先问问
R先生是否同意。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Okay, okay...
So what do you
think about that, Mr. R?
That alright with you?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧，好吧...
那么，R先生，您觉得怎么样？
您同意吗？

scripts.text:
[R.]
Of course, I'd like my
safety to be guaranteed,
but the information in those
documents is more important
than my life. Do whatever it
takes--please get them back.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
当然，我希望我的安全
能得到保障，
但那些文件中的信息
比我的生命更重要。
不惜一切代价——
请把它们取回来。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well then. Mr. R, you'll
stay here where I can protect
you. This place is also shielded
with security magic, so you'll
be just fine. Now, as for you,
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
那么。R先生，
您就留在这里，由我来保护您。
这里也有安全魔法保护，
所以您会很安全。
至于你，
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Your priority is to go
to the Juno Library and
bring Mr. R's documents
back over here. Hey, Mr. R,
how can we tell which are
your documents, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
你的首要任务是去朱诺图书馆，
把R先生的文件带回来。
嘿，R先生，
我们怎么分辨哪些是您的文件呢？

scripts.text:
[R.]
They're, um...
They're labeled with
the name, ''Moore.''
Just... another pseudonym.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
它们，嗯...
上面标着
“摩尔”的名字。
只是...另一个化名。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Once you're in the
Juno Library, find a
girl named ^4D4DFFYunia^000000. She'll
help make your job a lot
easier. Okay then, good luck~
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
到了朱诺图书馆后，
去找一个叫^4D4DFF尤妮娅^000000的女孩。
她会帮你的忙，
让事情变得容易得多。
那么，祝你好运~
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Head over to Juno
Library and speak to
a girl there named Yunia.
If anyone gets in your way,
just dispose of 'em. Punks
deserve whatever you give 'em!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
去朱诺图书馆，
和那里一个叫尤妮娅的女孩对话。
如果有人挡路，
就把他们解决掉。
那些朽魔
活该受到任何惩罚！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Er, but that's completely
up to you. Just wanted to let
you know that you wouldn't get
in trouble for assassinating when you're working with Assassins
is all I'm saying. Okay, seeya~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
呃，但这完全由你决定。
只是想让你知道，
当你和刺客一起工作时，
执行刺杀任务不会惹上麻烦。
就这样，再见~

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, were you able to
find Yunia? Wait a sec,
did you bring the documents?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，你找到尤妮娅了吗？
等一下，
你带文件回来了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh oh...
I guess I better
go back and talk
to Yunia once again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...
看来我最好
再回去和尤妮娅谈一次！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yunia gave you the
documents that Mr. R
wanted? Great, now go
bring them to him and
see what he wants us
to do for him next.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
尤妮娅给了你
R先生想要的文件？
太好了，现在把它们
带给他，
看看他接下来想让我们做什么。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah yes, these are exactly
what I wanted! Thank you so
much for your hard work. Wow,
these are so well organized...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
啊，是的，
这正是我想要的！
非常感谢你的辛勤工作。
哇，
这些整理得真好...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Huh. Now that we brought
him these documents, he's
probably gonna ask us to
do something else for him.
That's how it always works...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯。既然我们把
这些文件带给了他，
他大概会让我们
为他做别的事情。
总是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I guess we should do as
Mr. R asks. Go ahead and
check the field west of Morocc
for one of those artifacts or
crests, and I'll remain here
to guard Mr. R, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想我们应该
听从R先生的要求。
去梦罗克西边的野外
找找那些神器或纹章，
我会留在这里
保护R先生，以防万一。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry that ^A9A9A9WAIT^000000 you've
got to do ^A9A9A9FOR^000000 this ^A9A9A9ME^000000 alone,
^A9A9A9AT^000000 but this situation can't
be ^A9A9A9THE^000000 helped. ^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000

[Lin]
I don't really know
what's going on, but
it looks like we have
no choice but to do as
Mr. R. Moore asks for now...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我不太清楚
到底发生了什么，
但看起来我们目前
只能先听从
R. 摩尔先生的要求...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey... I need to talk to
you alone. This R. Moore guy...
I don't like him! Something's
not adding up quite right!
I've been going through his
research notes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿...我需要
和你单独谈谈。
那个R. 摩尔...
我不喜欢他！
总觉得哪里不对劲！
我一直在翻阅他的
研究日志，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
There's all this mention
of Morocc, Morocc Satan,
and Thanatos Tower... How
is this all connected to the
missing children? If you ask
me, it's pretty morbid stuff.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
里面提到了
梦罗克、梦罗克撒旦，
还有达纳托斯塔...
这和失踪的儿童
有什么关系？
在我看来，
这挺不吉利的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, I want you to find out
what you can from our local
historian in Morocc about Morocc Satan and all that. There's
too much we don't know, and
I don't wanna take chances.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，我想让你去
问问梦罗克当地的
历史学家，
关于梦罗克撒旦
以及那些事情。
我们知道的太少了，
我不想冒险。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Hm...?
What were you
talking about so
excitedly over there?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
嗯...？
你们刚才在那边
那么激动地
在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, we were just
talking about the those
elemental crests and how
they're now taken care of.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，我们只是在
谈论那些元素纹章，
以及它们现在
已经处理好了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Say, {0},
were you about to leave?
I had another reques--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
喂，{0}，
你正准备离开吗？
我还有另一个请求--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sending {0}
on a snack errand and it won't
take too long. Did you want him
to bring you back anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我派{0}
去买点零食，
不会花太长时间。
你要他给你带点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sending {0}
on a snack errand and it won't
take too long. Did you want her
to bring you back anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我派{0}
去买点零食，
不会花太长时间。
你要她给你带点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh, yes. On your way
back, would you bring
me a Tropical Sograt?
I'm very fond of those.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
哦，是的。
回来的路上，
能帮我带一份
热带的苏克拉特吗？
我很喜欢那个。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, {0},
you heard the ^A9A9A9GO^000000 man.
^A9A9A9TO^000000 Come back ^A9A9A9THE^000000 as soon
as ^A9A9A9HISTORIAN^000000 can, ^A9A9A9NOW^000000 alright?

[Lin]
Back so soon?
Did you forget what
I asked you to do?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
这么快就回来了？
你忘了我让你
做什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You were going
on a snack errand,
weren't you?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
你不是去
买零食了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Right. I ^A9A9A9GO^000000 guess ^A9A9A9FIND^000000 you
^A9A9A9THE^000000 came back because you
^A9A9A9HISTORIAN^000000 forgot something. 
Now hurry ^A9A9A9IN^000000 up, we're going to
need ^A9A9A9Morocc^000000 snacks ^A9A9A9NOW^000000 soon.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
没错。我^A9A9A9去^000000猜^A9A9A9找^000000你
^A9A9A9那^000000回来是因为你
^A9A9A9历史学家^000000忘了什么东西。
现在快点^A9A9A9在^000000，我们需要
^A9A9A9梦罗克^000000的零食^A9A9A9现在^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'm back...

[Lin]
I'm sorry, ^A9A9A9MEET^000000 partner,
but I forgot to ask you to
bring me a snack ^A9A9A9ME^000000 too.
Do you think you ^A9A9A9AT^000000 can
^A9A9A9THE^000000 get me a glass of, um...
^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000 Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，^A9A9A9见^000000伙伴，
我忘了让你
也给我带点零食^A9A9A9我^000000。
你觉得你^A9A9A9在^000000能
^A9A9A9那^000000给我弄一杯，嗯...
^A9A9A9楼梯^000000赤色海滩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Snack? Um... That's
more of a drink, isn't it?
But if that's what you want,
then I'll be back soon.
(^333333This is so cloak and dagger!
How does she talk like that?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
零食？嗯...那
更像是饮料，不是吗？
但如果你想要，
我很快就回来。
(^333333这也太像谍战片了！
她怎么说话像那样？^000000)

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, good.
You're finally back~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，太好了。
你终于回来了~

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah! You've finally returned.
I have another request that
I must ask of you that pertains
to the missing children.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
啊！你终于回来了。
我还有一个请求
必须拜托你，
这与失踪的儿童有关。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, alright.
Depending on what
it is, maybe we'll do it.
But if it's some crazy
nonsense errand, we won't.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
行，可以。
看是什么事，
也许我们会答应。
但如果是那种
莫名其妙的跑腿任务，
我们就不会做了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
For the sake of my
research, I want you to
investigate Thanatos Tower.
Learn more about its origin
through any means possible. I didn't want to say this, but...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
为了我的研究，
我希望你们去调查达纳托斯塔。
通过任何可能的途径，
了解它的起源。
我不想说这些，但是...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I think it's possible that the
missing children were kidnapped
to revive an ancient evil, Satan Morocc. I believe we can learn
more about the kidnappers by
learning about Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我认为失踪的儿童
可能被绑架，
是为了复活古代邪恶——魔王梦罗克。
我相信通过了解魔王梦罗克，
我们能更多地了解绑架者。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know this all sounds
crazy, but please trust me.
Thanatos Tower is somehow
related to Satan Morocc, so
if you could tell me what
you can learn from there...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我知道这听起来
很疯狂，但请相信我。
达纳托斯塔与魔王梦罗克
有某种联系，
所以如果你能告诉我
你在那里了解到的情况...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Thanatos Tower, huh?
Alright, it's not like we don't
believe you, but we need some
time to consider your request
before we can go ahead with the investigation you're asking for...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
达纳托斯塔，是吗？
好吧，我们不是不信你，
但在答应你的调查请求之前，
我们需要时间考虑一下...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright... Before
we go and do this, we
need to make absolutely
sure of a few things.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧... 在
我们去做这件事之前，
我们需要确认
几件事。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Of course.
What is it that
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
当然。
你想问我什么？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
First, those men that
attacked you. Are they
trying to revive Satan
Morocc? And those crests...
Were they built to break Satan
Morocc's seal or protect it?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
首先，那些
袭击你的人。
他们是为了复活魔王梦罗克吗？
还有那些纹章...
它们是为了打破魔王梦罗克的封印，
还是为了保护它？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh, my attackers. I have no
idea what they could want.
As for the elemental crests,
they were originally built by
a madman to revive Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
哦，我的袭击者。
我不知道他们想要什么。
至于元素纹章，
它们最初是由一个
疯子建造的，
目的是复活魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
However, once that crazed
man's plot was discovered,
the crests were modified to
further shield the seal that
contains Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
然而，当那个
疯子的阴谋被发现后，
纹章被改造，
以进一步保护
封印魔王梦罗克的封印。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
But as a historian...
These stories about Satan
Morocc and seals are just
conjecture. I need concrete
proof that the threat of
Satan Morocc truly exists.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
但作为一个历史学家...
关于魔王梦罗克
和封印的故事
只是推测。
我需要确凿的证据
证明魔王梦罗克的威胁
真实存在。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
If I can obtain that,
people would be able to
take Satan Morocc's threat
more seriously. And Thanatos Tower wouldn't be a tourist area.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
如果我获得了证据，
人们就会更认真地
对待魔王梦罗克的威胁。
达纳托斯塔也不会
只是一个旅游区。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I'm begging you, please
go to Thanatos Tower and
try to find some sort of solid
historical record that proves
that Satan Morocc really
existed in our world.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我恳求你，
请去达纳托斯塔，
试着找到某种
坚实的历史记录，
证明魔王梦罗克
真的存在于我们的世界。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm not sure what to
believe, but investigating
Thanatos Tower seems to be
our best course of action now.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我不确定该相信什么，
但调查达纳托斯塔
似乎是我们现在
最好的行动方案。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
While you work on that,
I will be trying to piece
together the information that
we've collected so far, as well
as keep an eye on Mr. R. Moore.
Good luck, and be careful.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
当你去处理这件事时，
我会尝试整理
我们目前收集到的信息，
并留意R. 摩尔先生。
祝你好运，小心。

scripts.text:
^3355FFLin seems to be lost
in thought, carefully
weighing your mission's
options. For now, you
better do your part and
investigate Thanatos Tower.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳似乎陷入了沉思，
仔细权衡着你任务的
选项。目前，你
最好做好你的部分，
调查达纳托斯塔。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
Right now, my life isn't
so important! Please let
me finish my research!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
现在，我的生命
并不那么重要！
请让我完成我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
I thought we're
only supposed to
protect you? What
exactly is going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什么...？
我以为我们
只是负责保护你？
到底发生了什么事？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I'm sorry, but it is
imperative that I leave
for the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
很抱歉，但我必须
立刻前往朱诺图书馆...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
talking about...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，
你们在说什么...？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，这位是{0}，
是我这次任务的搭档。
别担心，你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust her.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，这位是{0}，
是我这次任务的搭档。
别担心，你可以信任她。

scripts.text:
[R.]
Ah, I see. Please, for
for the sake of anonymity,
call me Mr. R. If it will help
you in your task, you may want
to ask Lin to explain everything that I just told her. Excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
啊，我明白了。
请，为了匿名，
叫我R. 先生。如果这
有助于你的任务，
你可能需要问琳
解释我刚才告诉她的所有内容。
失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生从项链上
取下一个吊坠，
放在额头上，
然后快速低声念了几句，
接着抬起头。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
Your partner should be
able to relate everything
that I've already told her,
as well as any details that
you might need to know for
your job. Please excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
你的搭档应该
能够转述我已经告诉她的所有内容，
以及你可能需要知道的
任何细节。请失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生从项链上
取下一个吊坠，
放在额头上，
然后快速低声念了几句，
接着抬起头。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
The Juno Library is
divided into 3 sections:
2 sections are used to store
books, and the other section
is dedicated for use as a
reading room or study hall.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
朱诺图书馆
分为3个部分：
2个部分用于存放书籍，
另一个部分专门用作
阅览室或自习室。

scripts.text:
[R.]
You should be able to
find Yunia in that study
hall. Hopefully, by that
time, she'll be finished
organizing my documents...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
你应该能在自习室里找到尤妮娅。
希望到时候她已经整理完我的文件了...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
So were you able to find
Yunia and get my research
documents from her? If you've
forgotten, then please go back
to Juno Library and bring them
back here... Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
你找到尤妮娅并拿到我的研究文件了吗？
如果你忘了，请回到朱诺图书馆把它们带回来...
再次感谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These are the documents
that I received from Yunia.
Is this what you needed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这些是我从尤妮娅那里拿到的文件。
这就是您需要的吗？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah yes, these are exactly
what I wanted! Thank you so
much for your hard work. Wow,
these are so well organized...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
啊，是的，
这正是我想要的！
非常感谢你的辛勤工作。
哇，
这些整理得真好...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright. You need to tell
us how your research is
related to our next job...
We need to protect you, but
we still want to help those
missing children if we can.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好的。你需要告诉我们你的研究与我们的下一个任务有什么关系...
我们需要保护你，但如果可能的话，我们也想帮助寻找那些失踪的孩子。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
The information in these
documents is related to my
next request for you. As your
client, I hope you will carry
out this task and consider it
part of your assignment.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
这些文件中的信息与我对您的下一个请求有关。
作为您的委托人，我希望您能执行这项任务，并将其视为工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, yeah, you don't
have to remind me. Besides,
we Assassins don't like leaving
any job unfinished. So what do
you need us to do this time?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是是是，不用你提醒。况且，我们刺客不喜欢留下未完成的任务。这次需要我们做什么？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
There are four crests
hidden in four different
directions around Morocc
which regulate the power
of the Water, Wind, Earth
and Fire elements in the area.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
在莫洛克的四个不同方向隐藏着四个纹章，它们调节着该区域水、风、土、火四种元素的力量。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
The stability of these
elements in Morocc is in
currently in question, so
I want you to ^4D4DFFuse enchanted
stones^000000 to strengthen the power
of these elemental crests.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
莫洛克这些元素的稳定性目前受到质疑，所以我想让你^4D4DFF使用附魔石^000000来增强这些元素纹章的力量。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Wait... We can honor
requests regarding your
safety, or anything that
will help us find those
missing kids, but we're your
bodyguards, not your servants.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
等等...我们可以接受关于你安全或帮助我们寻找失踪孩子的请求，但我们是你的保镖，不是你的仆人。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know, I know...
But whatever force has
been tampering with these
artifacts is probably responsible for kidnapping those children.
It's worth investigating...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我知道，我知道...
但无论是什么力量在篡改这些神器，很可能就是绑架那些孩子的元凶。
值得调查一下...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Regardless, those men
attacked me because they
did not want me to repair
Morocc's elemental equilibrium.
At least, that's what I believe.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
无论如何，那些人攻击我，是因为他们不想让我修复莫洛克的元素平衡。
至少，我是这么认为的。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You can't possibly
understand now, but
trust me... You don't want
those crests to weaken.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
你现在可能无法理解，但请相信我...
你不希望这些纹章变弱。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Why don't you search West
Morocc first for one of the
elemental artifacts since it
is closer? It should be where
the pyramids are located.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
既然西莫洛克离得更近，为什么不先在那里寻找一个元素神器呢？它应该就在金字塔附近。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Please go ahead
and do as he says.
In the meantime, I'll
stay here and make sure
no one attacks Mr. R again.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
请照他说的做吧。
在此期间，我会留在这里，确保没人再攻击R先生。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry that ^A9A9A9WAIT^000000 you've
got to do ^A9A9A9FOR^000000 this ^A9A9A9ME^000000 alone,
^A9A9A9AT^000000 but this situation can't
be ^A9A9A9THE^000000 helped. ^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000

[R. Moore]
You should be able to find
the element regulation device
behind one of the pyramids in
the field west of Morocc. Please
use an enchanted stone to
boost the crest's power.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
你应该能在莫洛克西侧田野的某个金字塔后面找到元素调节装置。请使用附魔石来增强纹章的力量。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Alright, now, I don't know
the locations of the other
crests. I wish I had the
chance to search for them
before I was attacked. I'm
sorry I can't be of more help.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
好了，现在，我不知道其他纹章的位置。真希望我在被攻击前有机会去寻找它们。抱歉我不能提供更多帮助。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I didn't know asking for
protection would require
me to live like a prisoner...
I feel... I feel trapped.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我不知道寻求保护会让我活得像个囚犯...
我感觉...我感觉被困住了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, what's your problem,
Mr. R?! You're snug as a rug
in here, next to freakin' pub
for goodness sake, while we're
running around doing all of
your dirty work for you!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，R先生，你怎么了？！你在这里舒舒服服的，旁边还有该死的酒吧，而我们在外面到处奔波替你干脏活！

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
This much is
true, I suppose...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
这倒是事实，我想...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess I'll go out
and try to activate those
other elemental crests
just outside of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我会出去试试激活莫洛克外面那些其他的元素纹章。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Thank you so much
for all of your hard
work. Future generations
will praise what you have
done. Rest assured...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
非常感谢你们的辛勤工作。
后世将会颂扬你们所做的事。
请放心...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
What did you
say just now?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什么...？
你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh nothing...
Just giving {0}
due credit. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
哦，没什么...
只是给予{0}应有的赞誉而已。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Good, you've arrived.
Now, to ensure the safety
of all of those poor children,
I need you to complete ano--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
很好，你来了。
现在，为了确保那些可怜孩子们的安全，
我需要你完成另一项任--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Excuse me, I don't mean
to butt in, but I need to
talk to you alone. It's
a very urgent issue that
I need to discuss here
with {0}.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，我不想插嘴，但我需要单独和你谈谈。
这是非常紧急的事情，
我必须在这里和{0}讨论。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
...Very well.
Then I shall next;
until you return.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
...好吧。
那么我先去那边；
等你回来再说。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Hmmm...?
Weren't you going
out on an errand to
pick up some snacks
and drinks for us?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
嗯...？
你不是要出去跑腿，
给我们买点零食和饮料吗？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh good, you've
returned. Never mind
the snacks, I want to
talk to you about my
next request if you wo--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
哦，你回来了。
零食的事先放一边，
我想和你谈谈我的下一个请求，如果你愿--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry, ^A9A9A9MEET^000000 partner,
but I forgot to ask you to
bring me a snack ^A9A9A9ME^000000 too.
Do you think you ^A9A9A9AT^000000 can
^A9A9A9THE^000000 get me a glass of, um...
^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000 Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，^A9A9A9见^000000伙伴，
我忘了让你
也给我带点零食^A9A9A9我^000000。
你觉得你^A9A9A9在^000000能
^A9A9A9那^000000给我弄一杯，嗯...
^A9A9A9楼梯^000000赤色海滩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Snack? Um... That's
more of a drink, isn't it?
But if that's what you want,
then I'll be back soon.
(^333333This is so cloak and dagger!
How does she talk like that?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
零食？嗯...那
更像是饮料，不是吗？
但如果你想要，
我很快就回来。
(^333333这也太像谍战片了！
她怎么说话像那样？^000000)

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah, you've finally returned.
I have another request that
I must ask of you that pertains
to the missing children.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
啊，你终于回来了。
我有一个新的请求必须拜托你，
这与失踪的孩子们有关。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, alright.
Depending on what
it is, maybe we'll do it.
But if it's some crazy
nonsense errand, we won't.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
行，可以。
看是什么事，
也许我们会答应。
但如果是那种
莫名其妙的跑腿任务，
我们就不会做了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
For the sake of my
research, I want you to
investigate Thanatos Tower.
Learn more about its origin
through any means possible. I didn't want to say this, but...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
为了我的研究，
我希望你们去调查达纳托斯塔。
通过任何可能的途径，
了解它的起源。
我不想说这些，但是...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I think it's possible that the
missing children were kidnapped
to revive an ancient evil, Satan Morocc. I believe we can learn
more about the kidnappers by
learning about Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我认为失踪的儿童
可能被绑架，
是为了复活古代邪恶——魔王梦罗克。
我相信通过了解魔王梦罗克，
我们能更多地了解绑架者。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know this all sounds
crazy, but please trust me.
Thanatos Tower is somehow
related to Satan Morocc, so
if you could tell me what
you can learn from there...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我知道这听起来
很疯狂，但请相信我。
达纳托斯塔与魔王梦罗克
有某种联系，
所以如果你能告诉我
你在那里了解到的情况...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Thanatos Tower, huh?
Alright, it's not like we don't
believe you, but we need some
time to consider your request
before we can go ahead with the investigation you're asking for...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
达纳托斯塔，是吗？
好吧，我们不是不信你，
但在答应你的调查请求之前，
我们需要时间考虑一下...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Lin has something to ask
me, so I should probably
answer her questions before
requesting you to do anything.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
琳有些问题要问我，
所以我应该先回答她的问题，
然后再拜托你做事。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I'm begging you, please
go to Thanatos Tower and
try to find some sort of solid
historical record that proves
that Satan Morocc really
existed in our world.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
我恳求你，
请去达纳托斯塔，
试着找到某种
坚实的历史记录，
证明魔王梦罗克
真的存在于我们的世界。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You'll be investigating
Thanatos Tower, then?
Good, good, I'll soon be
able to complete my work.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩尔]
你要去调查达纳托斯塔，是吗？
很好，很好，我很快就能完成我的工作。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生从项链上
取下一个吊坠，
放在额头上，
然后快速低声念了几句，
接着抬起头。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
...
......
Um. Hey.

[Kidd]
Oh hey, you're the one who's
working with Lin, right? We're
all glad you came on board for
that mission. I mean, we can't do everything ourselves, you know?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦嘿，你就是和琳一起工作的那个吧？
大家都很高兴你能加入那个任务。我是说，我们不可能什么都自己干，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
The representative from
the Dandelion organization
is waiting for us in the hall,
so you better hustle over to
him. Don't worry, I'll meet you
as soon as you get there.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
蒲公英组织的代表正在大厅等我们，
所以你最好快点过去找他。别担心，你一到达那里我就去找你。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh, hey...
You're here,
you really came back.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，嘿...
你来了，
你真的回来了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Excuse me...
But can we
talk for a second?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
打扰一下...
我们能谈一谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh, hey...
You're here,
you really came back.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，嘿...
你来了，
你真的回来了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Excuse me...
But can we
talk for a second?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
打扰一下...
我们能谈一谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something major is going
to happen... You've got to
call the other members of
Dandelion, and I've got to
contact everyone in my guild!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
要发生大事了...你必须召集蒲公英的其他成员，而我必须联系公会里的所有人！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Let me go, I can feel
something happening in
Morocc Castle! We have
to go over there right now!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
放开我，我能感觉到莫洛克城堡里正在发生什么！我们必须立刻赶过去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh good, you're here
just in time. This member
from Dandelion is going to
explain our mission to us.
Now, if you'll give him
your full attention...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，你来得正好。这位蒲公英成员将向我们解释任务内容。现在，请专心听他说...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you're the one
working with Kidd on this
mission? I'm your client,
the representative of the
Dandelion Organization.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
啊，原来你就是和基德一起执行这个任务的人？我是你的委托人，蒲公英组织的代表。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
If you don't already know,
we're a public service group
that does great volunteer work.
However, one of our projects,
a child daycare center, was
ruined by a Mr. Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
如果你还不知道的话，我们是一个公共服务团体，从事着伟大的志愿工作。然而，我们的一个项目——一家儿童日托中心，被一位名叫雷恩·摩尔的先生破坏了。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
It's horrible what he did:
Raiyan Moore kidnapped all
of the children at our daycare
center! We can't help but feel
responsible, and we're doing
all that we can to find them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
他做的事太可怕了：雷恩·摩尔绑架了我们日托中心的所有孩子！我们不禁感到自责，正在竭尽全力寻找他们...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
However, the people of
our organization don't have
the skills to find him, much
less deal with this dangerous
man. That's why we're asking
for your help in this matter.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
然而，我们组织的人没有能力找到他，更别提对付这个危险的人物了。这就是为什么我们请求你在这件事上提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's how the children
have been disappearing?
Hmm. According to Raiyan
Moore's profile, he's more
of an academic or a scholar
than a dangerous kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
原来孩子们就是这样失踪的吗？
嗯。根据雷恩·摩尔的档案，他更像是一位学者，而不是危险的绑架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Yes, he would appear
innocuous according to
the file we've given you,
but I do not think that
Raiyan Moore is a person
that we should underestimate.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
是的，根据我们给你的档案，他看起来人畜无害，但我认为雷恩·摩尔不是一个我们可以轻视的人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英组织的代表从衬衫下掏出一个项链吊坠，按在额头上，然后快速低声念了几句咒语。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Kidd? What...
What is he doing
with that pendant?^000000)

[Kidd]
I've seen him do that
a couple of times. I dunno,
I guess he's just praying.
Though, I doubt it's to any
deity or god or whatever
that I'm familiar with...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我见过他做这个动作好几次了。不知道，我想他只是在祈祷吧。不过，我怀疑他祈祷的对象并不是我所熟悉的任何神灵...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Anyway, back to the task at
hand. All we know is that our
target was last seen checking
out the Morocc ruins. Now, I think that we should begin our search 
by visiting the Juno Library.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好了，回到正题。我们只知道目标最后一次出现在莫洛克废墟。我想，我们应该先去朱诺图书馆开始我们的搜索。

scripts.text: Why should we go there?
scripts.translation: 为什么我们要去那里？

scripts.text: Right, I understand!
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Our target, Raiyan Moore
is a scholar, an academic.
If he was researching the
Morocc Ruins, there's a good
chance that he went to the
Juno Library beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我们的目标，雷恩·摩尔，是一位学者，一位学术研究者。如果他在研究莫洛克废墟，那么他之前很可能去过朱诺图书馆。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
If we're lucky, we might
find some clue as to what
Raiyan Moore is trying to do,
and where he might be now.
Pretty good idea, huh?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
如果运气好，我们可能会找到一些线索，了解雷恩·摩尔想做什么，以及他现在可能在哪儿。这主意不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I know that Juno is pretty
far, but I think it's the
best lead to follow for now.
It's not an easy journey to
make, so I wanna thank you
for being so understanding.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我知道朱诺挺远的，但我觉得这是目前最好的线索。旅途并不轻松，所以我很感谢你的理解。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Anyway, if we're lucky,
maybe someone there might
be familiar with Raiyan's work
and could point us in the right
direction. Alright then, I'll meet up with you in the Juno Library.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
总之，如果运气好，也许那里有人熟悉雷恩的研究，能给我们指个方向。那么，我会在朱诺图书馆与你汇合。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm...? What are you still
doing here? There's no need
to wait up for me, I'll just catch up with you at the Juno Library.
Besides, I've got a few other
things to take care of first...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...？你还在这里做什么？没必要等我，我会直接在朱诺图书馆追上你的。况且，我还有几件事要先处理...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey you, Dandelion guy,
you know why these four
directions in Morocc are
so important to Moore?
He wrote something about
it in his research journal.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那个蒲公英的家伙，你知道为什么莫洛克的这四个方向对摩尔来说很重要吗？他在研究日志里写过关于这一点的内容。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hm? No, not really.
In fact, it's even more
baffling. What could be
here in Morocc, and how
can it possibly relate
to the missing children?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
嗯？不，我不太清楚。事实上，这更让人困惑。莫洛克这里会有什么，它又怎么可能与失踪的孩子有关呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, well, it's all we
have to go on for now.
Although he's probably
gone by now, we need to
follow through on this lead... If we're lucky, we'll catch Moore.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是啊，目前我们只有这些线索。虽然他现在可能已经走了，但我们必须追查这条线索...如果运气好，我们就能抓住摩尔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
How should we go
about investigating the
four directions in Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...
我们该如何着手调查莫洛克的四个方向呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... Why don't we try
this? I'll check the south
part of Morocc for anything
out of the ordinary, while you
check the west part of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...不如这样？我去莫洛克南部看看有没有什么异常，你去莫洛克西部调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Since Moore was performing
historical research, it would
probably be best for you to
investigate the pyramids west
of Morocc. If you happen to find anything, then meet me back here.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
既然摩尔一直在做历史研究，你去调查莫洛克西部的金字塔应该最合适。如果你发现了什么，就回来这里找我。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Good luck to the
two of you. Although
I have no idea what you
might find, I hope that it
will lead you to Raiya Moore...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
祝你们好运。虽然我不知道你们会找到什么，但我希望它能引导你们找到雷恩·摩尔...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
For now, investigate
the west part of Morocc
where the pyramids are
located. If you find anything
that may interest Moore, come
back and report it to me here.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
总之，先去莫洛克西部的金字塔那里调查。如果你发现了任何摩尔可能会感兴趣的东西，就回来向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Ah, you've returned.
I found some sort of
elemental crest over in
the south part of Morocc.
It was full of Earth magic...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
啊，你回来了。
我在莫洛克南部发现了一块元素纹章。
那里充满了土属性魔法...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? I actually found the
Wind elemental crest west
of Morocc. Do you think this
means that there's elemental
crests in the fields north and
east of Morocc as well?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？我在莫洛克西部找到了风属性纹章。你觉得莫洛克北部和东部的野外也有元素纹章吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I'm not sure, but I can tell
that there's some serious power
in those elemental crests. Now,
from what we read in Moore's
research, the four directions
in Morocc have to be balanced.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我不确定，但我能感觉到那些元素纹章蕴含着强大的力量。根据摩尔的研究，莫洛克的四个方向必须保持平衡。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hmm. Although your mission
is to find Raiyan Moore and
rescue the missing children,
we cannot allow Moore to cause
more harm. We can't ignore the crests, and should check them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
嗯。虽然你们的任务是找到雷恩·摩尔并救回失踪的孩子，但我们不能任由摩尔继续作恶。我们不能忽视这些纹章，必须去检查它们...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I agree... In fact, the
Earth crest seemed pretty
unstable when I found it.
For now, go and stabilize
all four elemental crests
located just outside of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我同意...事实上，我发现土属性纹章时，它看起来很不稳定。总之，去稳定莫洛克外围的四块元素纹章吧。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
While you're doing that,
I'm going to visit Morocc's
local historian and see what
I can learn about those crests
and Raiyan Moore's intentions.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你去处理那些的时候，我要去拜访莫洛克当地的历史学家，看看能不能从那里了解到关于这些纹章和雷恩·摩尔意图的信息。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... If you want to
stabilize the crests, you'll
probably need to counter the
the element of a crest with the
opposing, superior element,
to balance them out, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...如果你想稳定纹章，大概需要用克制该纹章属性的、更高级的元素来平衡它们，我想是这样。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You'll need all four
types of those elemental
stones. Anyway, you already
know where the west crest is.
The south crest is in the lowest part of the field south of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你需要四种元素原石。总之，你已经知道西部纹章的位置了。南部纹章在莫洛克南部野地的最南端。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
As for the north and east
crest locations, you're on
your own. Anyway, don't forget
to bring a Flame Heart, Mystic
Frozen, Great Nature and
Rough Wind with you, okay?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
至于北部和东部纹章的位置，就靠你自己了。总之，别忘了带上火灵原石、冰灵原石、土灵原石和风灵原石，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Have you been able to
find the other elemental
crests? Don't forget to
stabilize them by using
elemental stones of a
superior, opposing element.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你找到其他的元素纹章了吗？别忘了用克制且更高级的元素原石来稳定它们。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Is that what happened?
I can't believe the historian
would do that, Kidd. Did you
explain why you needed to
speak to him, and let him
know that it was urgent?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
是这样吗？
真不敢相信历史学家会那样做，基德。你有没有向他解释你需要和他对话的原因，并让他知道情况紧急？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hell, yeah...!
Well, you know.
In my usual way...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
当然...！
嗯，你知道的。
用我惯常的方式...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just came back
from stabilizing those
elemental crests. Wait,
did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚从稳定那些元素纹章的地方回来。等等，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm not sure...
Kidd seems very upset
for some reason. I'm
guessing something must
have happened when he
went to visit that historian.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我不太清楚...
基德看起来非常沮丧。我猜他去拜访那位历史学家时一定发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright...
So you know how
I was supposed to
visit our historian?
He, um, refused to see me...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好吧...
你知道我本该去拜访我们的历史学家吧？
他，嗯，拒绝见我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Why would he do
something like that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...？！
他为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I have no idea!
But I personally think
that he's got something
against Assassins. So
I want you to go and
try talking to him...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我也搞不清楚！
