但我个人觉得他好像对刺客有意见。所以我想让你去和他对话试试...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second.
I'm an Assassin too!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下。
我也是刺客啊！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, but he already
recognizes me. At least
you can go in disguise...
You know, wear one of
those cute hats or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是啊，但他已经认出我了。至少你可以伪装一下...
你知道的，戴那种可爱的帽子之类的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, alright.
I'll try talking
to him for you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧。
我去帮你和他对话试试...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, alright.
I'll try talking
to him for you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧。
我去帮你和他对话试试...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You should be able to
find our local historian in
the Morocc Inn. If you can, ask
him about the crests around
Morocc and their importance.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你应该能在梦罗克旅馆找到我们的历史学家。如果可以的话，问问他关于梦罗克周围的纹章及其重要性。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
We need to gather as
many clues as we can
about Raiyan Moore's
research so that we can
better understand his motives.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我们需要尽可能多地收集关于莱恩·摩尔研究的线索，以便更好地理解他的动机。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, you're back.
So were you able to
talk to the historian?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，你回来了。
那你成功和历史学家对话了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Say, what's that
you're drinking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你在喝什么？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, this?
It's a Tropical Sograt.
Trust me, it's delicious.
Here, let me buy you a glass.
Master! Let me have another
glass of Tropical Sograt!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
哦，这个？
是热带的苏克拉特。
相信我，很好喝。
来，我请你喝一杯。
师父！再给我来一杯热带的苏克拉特！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright, alright~
Coming right up.
Here you are, enjoy.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
好好好~
马上就来。
给你，请慢用。
拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, drink that later.
Did you figure out why
the historian refused to
see me? Gimme your report~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那个待会儿再喝。
你搞清楚历史学家为什么拒绝见我了？给我汇报一下~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright, now tell me.
Were you able to talk
to the historian? Also,
did you figure out why
he didn't wanna talk to me?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好了，现在告诉我。
你成功和历史学家对话了吗？还有，
你搞清楚他为什么不想和我说话了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, that? I never got to
speak to the historian, but
I did talk to his assistant.
It turns out that you scared
him off by brandishing your
blades in front of him...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，那个？我没能和历史学家对话，但我和他的助手聊了。
原来是你在他面前挥舞刀刃把他吓跑了...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You gotta be kidding me!
I'm an Assassin! What am
I supposed to be doing if
not looking cool and totally
hardcore, huh? Damn babies...
So what else did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你在开玩笑吧！
我是刺客！如果不耍酷、不显得硬核，我还能干嘛？该死的家伙...
那你还打听到什么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, those elemental crests
are supposed to protect some
seal beneath Morocc Castle
that keeps this monster, Satan
Morocc, from invading our world. It might be just a legend, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那些元素纹章据说是为了封印梦罗克城堡下方的某个封印，
防止魔王梦罗克入侵我们的世界。这可能只是个传说，但是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The assistant told me that
Thanatos Tower was actually
a place originally used by
Satan Morocc to summon his
minions. Now, demons or angels
or whatever inhabit that tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
助手告诉我，达纳托斯塔原本是魔王梦罗克用来召唤手下魔物的地方。现在，那里住着恶魔、天使之类的存在。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright...
But what does all
this have to do with
the missing children?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好吧...
但这和失踪的儿童有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Let's say that
Raiyan Moore's goal is to
revive Satan Morocc, if it
truly exists. It might be
possible to do that by
offering a blood sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 假设莱恩·摩尔的目标是复活魔王梦罗克，如果它真的存在的话。通过献祭血液可能就能做到。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Then that would mean
that the children were
kidnapped to-- No way!
That's... That's sick!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
那意味着孩子们被绑架是为了... 不可能！
这... 这太变态了！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You know... I've been
thinking about what we
should do next. If Satan
Morocc really exists, then
that would be a worldwide
catastrophe, right?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你知道吗...我一直在想
接下来该怎么办。如果魔王梦罗克
真的存在，那将是一场
世界性的灾难，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
However, we don't really
know if such a powerful
monster really does exist.
I don't want to believe it,
but we gotta investigate the
possibility, find some proof.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
不过，我们并不确定
如此强大的魔物是否真的存在。
我不愿意相信，
但我们必须调查这种可能性，
找到一些证据。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
There are those seals
around Morocc, but we're
not sure if they help keep
Satan Morocc sealed, or if
their magic makes it easier for humans to live in that desert.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
梦罗克周围有一些海豹宝宝，
但我们不确定它们是为了
封印魔王梦罗克，
还是它们的魔法让人类
更容易在那片沙漠中生存。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, yeah, I know. Okay,
this is what we'll do. You go
to Thanatos Tower and see if
you can find those kids, Raiyan
Moore, or concrete proof of
Satan Morocc's existence.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯，嗯，我知道。好吧，
这是我们要做的。你去达纳托斯塔，
看看能不能找到那些孩子、
莱恩·摩尔，或者魔王梦罗克
存在的实证。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
If you're lucky enough to
encounter Raiyan Moore
while you're there, bring him
back, dead or alive, it doesn't
matter. In the meantime, I'll talk to the historian's assistant...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
如果你运气好，在那里
遇到了莱恩·摩尔，把他带回来，
死活不论。在此期间，
我会去见历史学家的助手...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
So how's the investigation of
Thanatos Tower coming along?
Did you learn anything about
Raiyan Moore or Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
那么，达纳托斯塔的
调查进展如何？
你有关于莱恩·摩尔
或魔王梦罗克的情报吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: No, not yet...
scripts.translation: 不，还没...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I found some old log
entries about Satan Morocc.
They pretty much confirm that
Satan Morocc is real, and that
it's sealed under Morocc Castle.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我找到了一些关于
魔王梦罗克的旧日志。
它们基本上证实了魔王梦罗克
是真实存在的，而且
它被封印在梦罗克城堡下方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Rekenber Corporation
is also responsible for the
tower's reconstruction, and
they ultimately plan to repair
all twelve of its levels.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雷肯贝尔公司也负责
这座塔的修复，
他们最终计划修复
全部十二层。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
So it's true...
Satan Morocc does exist.
If Raiyan Moore kidnapped
those children, then he must
be planning to sacrifice them
to revive that monster.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
所以是真的...
魔王梦罗克确实存在。
如果莱恩·摩尔绑架了
那些孩子，那他一定
打算献祭他们来复活那只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I wish we could say that we
were jumping to conclusions,
but Moore's research results
and his behavior... He can't be
planning anything else. This
is the worst case scenario...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我真希望我们是在
妄下结论，
但摩尔的研究成果
和他的行为...他不可能
在谋划别的事。这是
最坏的情况...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it!
We have to find
Raiyan Moore now!
We're running out of
time! What'll we do?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
该死！
我们必须立刻
找到莱恩·摩尔！
时间不多了！
我们该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... Your investigation
wasn't thorough enough. You
need to find concrete proof about Satan Morocc's existence or Raiyan
Moore's intentions. Hurry back to Thanatos Tower and find it!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...你的调查
不够彻底。你需要找到
关于魔王梦罗克存在或莱恩·摩尔
意图的实证。快回达纳托斯塔
找到它！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright. Come back
as soon as you finish
your investigation. I'm
getting the feeling that we
no longer have the luxury
of time, so please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好的。调查结束后
尽快回来。我有一种
感觉，我们已经没有
时间可以浪费了，
请快点！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
We need to calm down...
We're no good to those
kids if we let ourselves
get frustrated. Okay, did
you find any trace of Raiyan
Moore over at Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我们需要冷静下来...
如果我们让自己沮丧，
对孩子们毫无帮助。好吧，
你在达纳托斯塔找到
莱恩·摩尔的踪迹了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I've been
asking around, but haven't
been able to get any clue as
to where he can be right now.
How can we possibly find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全没有。我四处打听，
但没能得到任何关于他
现在在哪里的线索。
我们怎么可能找到他？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
This is bad... Not only
are the missing children in
danger, but if Raiyan may even
revive Satan Morocc. We cannot
allow that to happen at any cost.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
情况不妙...失踪的孩子们
处于危险之中，而且如果莱恩
甚至可能复活魔王梦罗克。
无论如何，我们不能
让那发生。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I know, I've been
searching places where
the children might have
been hidden, but there's
just so many of them. We
really got to think of ou--
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我知道，我一直在
搜索孩子们可能被藏匿的地方，
但地方太多了。我们
真的得好好想一...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Um? I'm really sorry to
interrupt. I know I'm not
supposed to bother you guys
on assignment, but I overheard
you and wanted to ask about
the guy you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嗯？真的很抱歉
打扰了。我知道我不该
在你们执行任务时打扰，
但我听到了你们的谈话，
想问问你们在找的那个人。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You mean...
Raiyan Moore?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你是说...
莱恩·摩尔？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Yeah. Does he wear
the same uniform as you?
If he does, I think I saw him
here earlier going by the name
of ''Mr. R.'' Also, I think he
might also be Lin's client...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
是的。他穿的制服
和你的一样吗？
如果是的话，我想我刚才
在这里见过他，他自称
“R先生”。而且，我觉得
他可能也是琳的客户...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
What, Lin's client?!
Wait, {0}, do you recall
what Lin's assignment was?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
什么，琳的客户？！
等等，{0}，你还记得
琳的任务是什么吗？

scripts.text: Well, um...
scripts.translation: 嗯，那个...

scripts.text: Bodyguard, right?
scripts.translation: 保镖，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it!
I don't remember
it either! But I've got
a bad feeling about this!
We gotta go talk to our
commanding officer!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
该死！
我也不记得了！但我
有种不好的预感！
我们得去见指挥官！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's right! She's
supposed to be a bodyguard
for someone called ''Mr. R!''
How could we overlook this?!
Damn it, we need to talk to our
commanding officer right now!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
没错！她应该是
“R先生”的保镖！
我们怎么会忽略这一点？！
该死，我们现在就得
去见指挥官！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, hey...
What's going on?
Was I not supposed to
tell that to you guys?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，嘿...
发生什么事了？
我不该告诉你们
这些吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
No, no...
You were actually
a really great help!
Thanks, Litheron, 
I'll buy you a drink later~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
不，不...
你帮了大忙！
谢谢，利瑟隆，
回头请你喝一杯~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Now I remember...!
Lin is supposed to work
as a bodyguard for someone
named, ''Mr. R!'' We're looking
for Raiyan Moore--if they're the same person-- then that means--
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我想起来了...！
琳应该是
“R先生”的保镖。我们在找
莱恩·摩尔——如果是同一个人——
那就意味着——

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hurry, we need to tell
our commanding officer,
Valdes! I'll meet you there
in a flash, so just get over
there as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
快，我们要去告诉
指挥官瓦尔德斯！我马上
就到，你尽快赶过去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Raiyan Moore's supposed
to be in the room on the other
side of the commanding officer's room. Check it, quickly! Once
I get my hands on that guy...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
莱恩·摩尔应该在
指挥官房间隔壁的房间里。
快去查一下！等我抓到
那个人...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something huge is going
on at Morocc Castle. If that's
where Satan Morocc is sealed,
then the demon is beginning
to revive. We gotta stop it before Satan Morocc can enter our world!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
梦罗克城堡正在发生
大事。如果那里封印着
魔王梦罗克，那么恶魔
正在苏醒。我们必须在魔王梦罗克
进入我们的世界之前阻止他！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Man, that was close!
We got really lucky.
Yeah... Let's talk about this
some more with Valdes in
the commanding officer's room.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
天哪，好险！
我们运气真好。
是的...让我们去指挥官
房间和瓦尔德斯再谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I still can't believe it...
Those poor, poor children...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我还是不敢相信...
那些可怜，可怜的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, you're...
You're Lin's partner,
aren't you? Good luck
working with her-- she
can be pretty bossy.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，你是...
你是琳的搭档，
对吧？祝你们合作愉快——
她可能有点强势。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it, I feel like
we all failed. I can
understand how Lin feels.
Still, I hate standing by
and waiting around...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
该死，我觉得
我们都失败了。我能
理解琳的感受。
但我讨厌只能站在这里
等待...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
H-hey...!
Did you feel that?
That eerie vibration
of incredibly dark power...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你...你感觉到了吗？
那种令人毛骨悚然的
黑暗灵魂之力的震动...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something major is going
to happen... You've got to
call the other members of
Dandelion, and I've got to
contact everyone in my guild!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
要发生大事了...你必须召集蒲公英的其他成员，而我必须联系公会里的所有人！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Let me go, I can feel
something happening in
Morocc Castle! We have
to go over there right now!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
放开我，我能感觉到莫洛克城堡里正在发生什么！我们必须立刻赶过去！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Have you ever heard of
the Dandelion organization?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你听说过
蒲公英组织吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you already know
about us? I feel so ashamed...
We let that Raiyan Moore kidnap
the children that were entrusted to our care. I don't know if we
can ever forgive ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
啊，原来你已经
知道我们了？真让我惭愧...
我们竟然让那个莱恩·摩尔
绑架了托付给我们的孩子。我不知道
我们是否还能原谅自己。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You really haven't?
Well, I suppose we're
not a very popular or
glamorous group. Basically,
we're a non-profit organization working to improve public welfare.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你完全不知道？
嗯，我想我们
并不是一个很受欢迎或
光鲜的组织。基本上，
我们是一个致力于改善
公共福利的非营利组织。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
We volunteer to clean the
streets, repair homes for
lower income households, and
even operated a day care center.
However, Raiyan Moore kidnapped all the children under our care...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我们志愿清扫街道，为低收入家庭修缮房屋，甚至经营了一所托儿所。
然而，莱恩·摩尔绑架了所有托付给我们照顾的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I can only imagine the
suffering those poor kids
must be going through. I hope
that we can save them soon!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我只能想象那些可怜的孩子正在遭受怎样的痛苦。希望我们能尽快救出他们！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you're the one
working with Kidd on this
mission? I'm your client,
the representative of the
Dandelion Organization.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
啊，原来你就是和基德一起执行这个任务的人？我是你的委托人，蒲公英组织的代表。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
If you don't already know,
we're a public service group
that does great volunteer work.
However, one of our projects,
a child daycare center, was
ruined by a Mr. Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
如果你还不知道的话，我们是一个公共服务团体，从事着伟大的志愿工作。然而，我们的一个项目——一家儿童日托中心，被一位名叫雷恩·摩尔的先生破坏了。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
It's horrible what he did:
Raiyan Moore kidnapped all
of the children at our daycare
center! We can't help but feel
responsible, and we're doing
all that we can to find them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
他做的事太可怕了：雷恩·摩尔绑架了我们日托中心的所有孩子！我们不禁感到自责，正在竭尽全力寻找他们...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
However, the people of
our organization don't have
the skills to find him, much
less deal with this dangerous
man. That's why we're asking
for your help in this matter.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
然而，我们组织的人没有能力找到他，更别提对付这个危险的人物了。这就是为什么我们请求你在这件事上提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's how the children
have been disappearing?
Hmm. According to Raiyan
Moore's profile, he's more
of an academic or a scholar
than a dangerous kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
原来孩子们就是这样失踪的吗？
嗯。根据雷恩·摩尔的档案，他更像是一位学者，而不是危险的绑架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Yes, he would appear
innocuous according to
the file we've given you,
but I do not think that
Raiyan Moore is a person
that we should underestimate.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
是的，根据我们给你的档案，他看起来人畜无害，但我认为雷恩·摩尔不是一个我们可以轻视的人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英组织的代表从衬衫下掏出一个项链吊坠，按在额头上，然后快速低声念了几句咒语。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
All we know is that
Raiyan Moore has last
been spotted investigating
the ruins around Morocc.
For now, I suggest that you plan your next action with Kidd.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我们只知道，莱恩·摩尔最后出现在梦罗克附近的废墟进行调查。
目前，我建议你先和基德商量下一步的行动。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英组织的代表从衬衫下掏出一个项链吊坠，按在额头上，然后快速低声念了几句咒语。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Are you leaving now?
I hope that you catch
Raiyan Moore and that
you can rescue those
poor kids. Only a monster
would stoop to kidnapping...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你现在就要走了吗？
希望你能抓住莱恩·摩尔，
救出那些可怜的孩子。只有魔物才会做出绑架这种卑鄙行径...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
So you found some
sort of clue as to where
Raiyan would be? I agree
that it sounds like a long
shot, but we've got to try
everything that we can!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
看来你找到了一些关于莱恩·摩尔下落的线索？
虽然听起来希望渺茫，但我们必须尝试一切可能的方法！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan seems to have
been conducting some very
peculiar research. What could
the meaning of ''Morocc's four
directions'' be? How can it
possibly be of significance?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
莱恩·摩尔似乎在进行一些非常古怪的研究。
“梦罗克的四个方位”是什么意思？
这怎么可能有什么意义呢？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
So you're really going to
check the four directions
in Morocc... What could
possibly interest Raiyan
Moore in Morocc? Perhaps
he is not just a kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
所以你真的要去检查梦罗克的四个方位...
莱恩·摩尔对梦罗克有什么兴趣？
也许他不仅仅是一个绑架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You found a crest shaped
like the Wind? Ah, Kidd
mentioned that he found an
elemental crest imbued with
the power of Earth. You should
share your findings with him...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
你找到了一个风之形状的纹章？啊，基德说他找到了一个蕴含大地之力的元素纹章。你应该把你的发现分享给他...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I don't understand what
could be so important about
these elemental crest devices
hidden in Morocc. What could
Raiyan Moore be planning...?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我不明白为什么这些隐藏在梦罗克的元素纹章装置如此重要。莱恩·摩尔到底在谋划什么...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Is that what happened?
I can't believe the historian
would do that, Kidd. Did you
explain why you needed to
speak to him, and let him
know that it was urgent?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
是这样吗？
真不敢相信历史学家会那样做，基德。你有没有向他解释你需要和他对话的原因，并让他知道情况紧急？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hell, yeah...!
Well, you know.
In my usual way...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
当然...！
嗯，你知道的。
用我惯常的方式...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just came back
from stabilizing those
elemental crests. Wait,
did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚从稳定那些元素纹章的地方回来。等等，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm not sure...
Kidd seems very upset
for some reason. I'm
guessing something must
have happened when he
went to visit that historian.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我不太清楚...
基德看起来非常沮丧。我猜他去拜访那位历史学家时一定发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Now why would Morocc's
local historian refuse to see
Kidd? Maybe he didn't fully
understand the importance
of this mission? How strange...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
梦罗克当地的历史学家为什么拒绝见基德？也许他没有完全理解这次任务的重要性？真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
We have so very few leads
to finding Raiyan Moore, it's
completely frustrating. I know
that we have no choice, but
I'm worried to death about
those kidnapped children...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
我们要找到莱恩·摩尔的线索太少了，真是令人沮丧。我知道我们别无选择，但我对那些被绑架的孩子非常担忧...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Try not to worry
so much. We'll just
do what we always do:
everything we can. I only
hope it'll be enough this time.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
别太担心了。
我们会像往常一样：
尽我们所能。我只希望这次能成功。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, you've returned?
Were you able to talk to
the historian? Heh, while you
were gone, I've been helping
myself to some of these drinks~
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
哦，你回来了？
你见到历史学家了吗？呵呵，趁你不在的时候，我喝了一些这些饮料~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Say, what's that
you're drinking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你在喝什么？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, this?
It's a Tropical Sograt.
Trust me, it's delicious.
Here, let me buy you a glass.
Master! Let me have another
glass of Tropical Sograt!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
哦，这个？
是热带的苏克拉特。
相信我，很好喝。
来，我请你喝一杯。
师父！再给我来一杯热带的苏克拉特！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright, alright~
Coming right up.
Here you are, enjoy.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
好好好~
马上就来。
给你，请慢用。
拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, drink that later.
Did you figure out why
the historian refused to
see me? Gimme your report~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那个待会儿再喝。
你搞清楚历史学家为什么拒绝见我了？给我汇报一下~

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Isn't Tropical Sograt
so good? I can't believe
Assassins can enjoy this
drink whenever they want~
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
热带的苏克拉特真好喝啊！真不敢相信刺客们想喝就能喝~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Don't forget that
we've got a mission
to finish! Come on,
gimme your report now.
What'd you learn exactly?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
别忘了我们还有任务要完成！
快点，现在汇报一下。
你具体查到了什么？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan Moore...
The missing children...
Satan Morocc and Thanatos
Tower. They couldn't all be
connected somehow, can they?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
莱恩·摩尔...
失踪的孩子...
魔王梦罗克和达纳托斯塔。它们之间不可能有什么联系吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I hope that you'll be
able to find Raiyan Moore
at Thanatos Tower. Though,
it's a public place, so I don't
think he'd linger there for
too long. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
希望你能找到莱恩·摩尔在达纳托斯塔。不过，
那里是个公共场所，我想他不会在那里逗留太久。祝你好运...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
That monster...
So he kidnapped the
children to-- to sacrifice
them?! That's... unthinkable.
All to bring back some dead
demon? Why would he do that?!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
那个魔物...
他绑架孩子是为了——为了牺牲他们？！这...简直不可思议。
只是为了复活某个死去的恶魔？他为什么要这么做？！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan Moore kidnapped
the children to revive Satan
Morocc, and had the nerve
to hire the Assassin Guild
to protect him?! He's truly
a devious mastermind...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
莱恩·摩尔绑架孩子是为了复活魔王梦罗克，竟然还有脸雇佣刺客公会来保护他？！他真是个狡猾的阴谋家...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Being duped by that guy...
I've never been so insulted!
It's decided: that Raiyan
Moore doesn't deserve
to take another breath.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
被那个家伙骗了...
我从未如此受辱！
决定了：那个莱恩·摩尔不配再呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I can't believe that
Raiyan Moore was under
our noses this whole time...
Do you know where he is now?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
真不敢相信，莱恩·摩尔竟然一直就在我们身边...
你知道他现在在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah. Yeah...
Don't get too
worked up, he'll
be right here soon.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
知道。知道...
别太激动，他很快就会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
This is bad news...
It looks like Raiyan Moore
is performing the ritual to
revive Satan Morocc. We need
to go to Morocc Castle, where
Satan Morocc is sealed...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
这是坏消息...
看起来莱恩·摩尔正在举行复活魔王梦罗克的仪式。我们需要去梦罗克城堡，那里封印着魔王梦罗克...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Well, we've sent some
people to purse Raiyan,
though I honestly doubt
that they'll be able to get
him. Luckily, though, you
seem to be alright...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
嗯，我们已经派人去追捕莱恩了，
不过说实话，我不认为他们能抓到他。幸运的是，
你似乎没事...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm sorry...
But I'm far too busy
to speak with you now.
This matter requires
my full attention!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
抱歉...
但我现在太忙了，
没时间和你对话。
这件事需要我全神贯注！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Those poor children...
And what are we going
to tell their parents?
Still, perhaps this is
the will of ^4D4DFFFreya^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
那些可怜的孩子...
我们要怎么告诉他们的父母？
不过，也许这正是^4D4DFF芙蕾雅^000000的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Their deaths may have
been horrific, but I believe
that those children are now
safe in Freya's loving arms.
Who can understand the 
divine will of Freya?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成员]
他们的死可能很惨烈，但我相信
那些孩子现在正安然地躺在芙蕾雅慈爱的怀抱中。
谁能理解芙蕾雅的神圣旨意呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Freya...?
I thought most
people around here
prayed to Odin. Well,
I suppose that explains
a couple things.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
芙蕾雅...？
我以为这里大多数人
都崇拜奥丁。好吧，
这就解释了一些事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but may I ask
you a question? I'm hoping
that you might be able to
help me with something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，我可以问你个问题吗？我希望
你能帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Eh? Oh, I'm sorry, I was
so busy reading this book!
So, uh, what exactly did
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
啊？哦，对不起，我刚才
太专心看这本书了！
那么，呃，你具体想问什么？

scripts.text: Do you know Raiyan Moore?
scripts.translation: 你认识莱恩·摩尔吗？

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什么书？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Raiyan Moore?
I don't know any--
Oh, you must mean
Mr. R. Moore. Yes,
I suppose I do if his
first name is Raiyan.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
莱恩·摩尔？
我不认识什么——
哦，你一定是说
R. 摩尔先生。是的，
如果他的名字是莱恩的话，
我想我确实认识他。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I'm Yunia, Mr. Moore's
temporary assistant while
he's working on his current
research project. I can't make
heads or tails out of whatever
he's been studying, though...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
我是尤妮娅，是R. 摩尔先生
在研究当前项目期间的临时助手。我完全搞不懂
他在研究什么...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great, when was the
last time you've seen
him? You see, we're
actually looking for him...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了，你最后一次见到他是什么时候？你看，我们
其实正在找他...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I actually saw him here
everyday in the library up
until a couple days ago. That's
when these strange men tried
to capture him, but luckily he
was able to escape.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
实际上，直到几天前，我每天都在图书馆见到他。就在那时，
那些奇怪的男人们试图抓他，但幸运的是他
逃掉了。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I remember that things
were so crazy that day,
and Mr. Moore even forgot
to bring his documents with
him while he was running away.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
我记得那天非常混乱，
而且摩尔先生逃跑时甚至忘了带他的文件。

scripts.text: Documents?
scripts.translation: 文件？

scripts.text: Where did he go?
scripts.translation: 他去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Yes, he was perusing
some historic documents
before he ran off. They're
all about history, so I couldn't really understand them at all...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
是的，他在逃跑前正在翻阅
一些历史文件。它们都是关于历史的，所以我完全看不懂...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mm... I really don't
know? But I did keep and
organize the documents that
he was researching so that
they'll be ready when he
comes back to the library.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
嗯...我真的不知道。不过我把他研究的那些文件都整理好了，等他回到图书馆就能直接用。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... you know.
It's just this novel
About a boy who becomes.
a slave and he needs to
pay off his parents' debts.
But then, he falls in love...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
哦...你知道的。
就是那本小说，
讲一个男孩变成奴隶，
需要偿还父母的债务。
然后，他坠入了爱河...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
And the girl he falls
in love with? He doesn't
know it yet, but she's the
dark overlord of darkness!
At least, I think she is. They
keep hinting at it, though.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
而他爱上那个女孩？
他还没发现，
但她其实是黑暗势力的统治者！
至少我是这么觉得的，
虽然剧情一直在暗示这一点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was wondering if
I could look through
that Mr. Moore was studying...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在想能不能看看
摩尔先生研究的那些文件...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Well, I gave most of the
documents that I organized
to someone else already, but
now that I think about it, there are a few leftover, unorganized
files that you can check out.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
嗯，我整理的大部分文件
已经交给别人了，
不过现在想想，
还有几份没整理的文件，
你可以看看。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Actually, the person that took
the organized documents did
so on Mr. Moore's behalf. Then,
she quickly vanished before
I could ask her for her name or Mr. Moore's contact information.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
其实，拿走那些整理好的文件的人
是受摩尔先生委托的。
然后，
她在我问出她的名字
或摩尔先生的联系方式之前
就迅速消失了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn! That information
would have been really
helpful! (^333333I better not let
her know that I'm actually
trying to hunt Raiyan Moore^FFFFFF ^333333 down, or that he's a kidnapper.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死！那些信息
本来会很有用的！
(^333333我最好别让她知道
我其实是在追捕
R. 摩尔，^FFFFFF ^333333或者知道他是绑匪。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I hope Mr. Moore is
alright. Oh, why don't
you try reading his notes
and his journal on his desk?
That might be really helpful.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
希望摩尔先生没事。
哦，你不妨读读他桌上
的笔记和日记，
那可能会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mr. Moore's desk?
Just go upstairs and
look for it in the corner.
You should be able to
easily find his notes and
journal right on top of it.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
摩尔先生的桌子？
直接上楼，
在角落里找找。
你应该能很容易地
在桌上找到他的笔记
和日记。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but I'm
looking for a Ms. Yunia?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，
我在找尤妮娅小姐？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh, that's me!
So how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
哦，就是我！
那么，有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Mr. R's Documents
scripts.translation: R. 摩尔的文件

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什么书？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mr. R? Ohhhh...
Mr. R. Moore. Is...
Is he alright? I was
so scared when those
strange men attacked him
right here in Juno Library!
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
R. 先生？哦...
R. 摩尔。他...
他没事吧？
当那些奇怪的男人在
朱诺图书馆袭击他时，
我吓坏了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, he's perfectly safe.
We've got a professional to
ensure nothing happens to him.
But yes, he wanted me to come
here to pick up some research documents. Do you know about that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，他非常安全。
我们有专业人士
确保他万无一失。
不过是的，他让我来
这里取一些研究文件。
你知道这件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Ah, yes, I do!
I've been organizing
them for his return.
Would you like to take
a look before delivering
them to Mr. R. Moore?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
啊，是的，我知道！
我一直在为他的归来
整理这些文件。
在交给 R. 摩尔之前，
你想先看看吗？

scripts.text: May I?
scripts.translation: 可以吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks...
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Heh heh~ Alright~
First you should make sure
that the documents you're
delivering are the ones
that he needs, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
嘿嘿~ 好吧~
首先，你应该确认
你要交付的文件
是他需要的那些，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... You know. Just this
story about this guy who's
cursed so that he transforms
into a fat dork around beautiful girls, and into a svelte, handsome
man around dorky women.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
哦...你知道的。
就是那个故事，
讲一个被诅咒的家伙，
在漂亮女孩面前会变成
一个肥胖的笨蛋，
而在笨蛋女人面前
会变成帅气苗条的男人。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
So then he gets into this
crazy love triangle, and now
I'm at the part when he has to
go on a date with both a gorgeous girl AND a geeky girl. How's
he going to transform next...?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
然后他陷入了
一段疯狂的三角恋，
现在剧情到了他必须
同时和一个漂亮女孩
和一个书呆子女孩约会。
他接下来要怎么变...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Okay, these should
be the documents that
Mr. Moore wants to read.
Just read through them
quickly to make sure that
I gave you the right ones.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
好的，这些应该
就是摩尔先生
想要阅读的文件。
请快速浏览一遍，
确认我给你的
是正确的那些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see here...
Some of these sentences
are underlined... Ah, and here
are some notes in the margins.
Maybe this'll tell me about
Mr. R. Moore's research...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我看看...
有些句子被划了线...
啊，这里还有一些
页边笔记。
也许这能告诉我
R. 摩尔先生的研究内容...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffSatan Morocc appeared,
turning the world into a
living hell. Somehow, the
monster was sealed, and a
castle and town was built over^FFFFFF ^4d4dff its prison. This place is Morocc.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff魔王梦罗克出现了，
将世界变成了
人间地狱。不知怎的，
魔物被封印了，
一座城堡和城镇
建在它的监狱之上^FFFFFF ^4d4dff。这个地方就是梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, that's actually
pretty interesting. But
I need to do my job first.
Perhaps I'll ask Mr. R. Moore
about this later. Hey, Yunia,
thanks for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，这其实
挺有趣的。但我
得先做我的工作。
也许之后我会
问问R. 摩尔先生
关于这件事。嘿，尤妮娅，
谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
You're welcome~
Oh, and please give
my regards to Mr. Moore
when you see him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
不客气~
哦，还有，见到摩尔先生
时请代我问候他，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
But what are
you reading?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下...
但你在读
什么书？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... You know.
This story about this girl
who becomes a princess.
And then she owns this harem
of handsome boys, see? But
then, she meets this one boy...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
哦...你知道的。
就是那个故事，
讲一个女孩
变成了公主。
然后她拥有了
一群帅哥后宫，懂吗？
但后来，她遇到了
一个男孩...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
This boy refuses to join
her harem, and it's, like, so
ironic because he's the one she
really wants. Even though any
other boy in the world would
join her harem ^FF0000willingly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
这个男孩拒绝加入
她的后宫，这真是
太讽刺了，因为他
才是她真正想要的。
尽管世界上
其他任何男孩
都会^FF0000心甘情愿^000000地加入她的后宫。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Anyway, I'm reading the part
where he-- his name's Extopher-- has to defeat Count Guillermo
in a sword duel for the right
to ride the unicorn pegasus.
Ooh, what'll happen next?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
总之，我正在读
他——他叫Extopher——
必须与Guillermo伯爵
进行剑术决斗，
以赢得骑乘
独角兽飞马的权利。
噢，接下来会发生什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a crumpled piece
of paper filled with scribbles.
Apparently, this was ripped
from Moore's journal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一张
皱巴巴的纸，
上面写满了涂鸦。
显然，这是从
摩尔的日记本上
撕下来的。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nuts...
I came all the
way to Juno to look
through some trash?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死...
我大老远
跑到朱诺，
就是为了看
一堆垃圾？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
For the sake of those
missing kids, we're duty
bound to sift through every
piece of possible evidence,
not matter how useless it may
look! Don't throw it away yet!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
为了那些
失踪的孩子，
我们有责任
仔细检查每一片
可能的证据，
无论它看起来
多么没用！
先别把它扔掉！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Holy--!
You just came
out of nowhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪--!
你刚才
是从哪里冒出来的！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Sorry. I did tell
you I'd meet you here
in Juno. Anyway, let's
both take a careful look at
this paper from Moore's desk.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
抱歉。我确实
告诉过你
我会在朱诺
和你见面。
总之，让我们
一起仔细看看
这张来自摩尔
书桌的纸。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Morocc...
Were summoned...
Through the tower...?
This handwriting is so
bad, it's barely legible.
Can you read any of this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...梦罗克...
被召唤了...
通过中央塔...？
这字迹太潦草了，
几乎无法辨认。
你能读出
其中任何内容吗？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Uhhh... Tower...
Prontera... Impact created...
Desert? Must... four directions
in Morocc... Oh! Balance the
four directions in Morocc
to prevent a great evil.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呃...中央塔...
普隆德拉...冲击产生了...
沙漠？必须...梦罗克的
四个方向...噢！平衡
梦罗克的四个方向，
以防止巨大的邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Sorry, that's all I can read, but it must be important: if Moore
spent the time to write that
part clearly, then he must be
planning to investigate the
four directions in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
抱歉，我只能读出这些，但这一定很重要：如果摩尔
花了时间
把这部分写得
很清楚，那么他一定
打算调查
梦罗克的四个方向。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I'm not sure what it
could all mean, but I'm
gonna bring this part of
his journal with me. I'll
meet you back in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我不确定
这一切意味着什么，
但我会把
他日记本的这部分
带在身上。
我会在梦罗克
和你见面。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a journal filled
with illegible scribbles.
It's impossible for you to
decipher the writing inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一本
写满无法辨认
涂鸦的日记本。
你无法破译
里面的文字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a journal that is
missing many of its pages
and filled with illegible
scribbles. It's impossible
for you to decipher what
could be written inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一本
缺失了许多页
且写满无法辨认
涂鸦的日记本。
你无法破译
里面可能写的内容。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find what appears to
be somebody's research
journal. It's best not to
touch it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一本看起来像是某人的研究日记。现在最好不要碰它。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright, we need
to talk for a second
about this assignment.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧，我们需要就这个任务谈一谈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Waaa-!
You came out
of nowhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊——！
你从哪冒出来的！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Sorry for scaring you.
We don't have time, so I'll
get straight to the point.
I don't trust our client.
However, for the time being,
we should do what he says.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉吓到你了。
没时间了，我直入正题。
我不信任我们的委托人。
不过，目前我们还是应该照他说的做。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
In the meantime, keep
an eye out. If you find
anything that might suggest
that Mr. R isn't telling us the
truth for some reason, let
me know. I'll see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
在此期间，保持警惕。
如果你发现任何迹象表明
R先生因为某种原因
没有对我们说实话，
请告诉我。回头见。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, I gotta talk to you
real quick without Mr. R
overhearing... I'm not
taking any chances with him!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，我得在你和R先生
听到之前快速说几句...
我不想在他身上冒任何风险！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I tried to visit our local
historian to learn more about
Mr. R's research. To do that,
I left Mr. R alone for a little
while under our magic security system. However, I kinda failed.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我试图拜访当地的历史学家，
以了解更多关于R先生研究的信息。
为此，我在我们的魔法安保系统下
让R先生独自待了一会儿。然而，我有点失败了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I got a little peeved at
the historian guy, and he
got a little intimidated. Now
he's holed up somewhere
in the Morocc Inn, and I don't
think he's seeing anybody.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我对那个历史学家有点生气，
他也变得有点害怕了。现在他躲在
梦罗克旅馆的某个地方，
我想他不见任何人。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I want you to find Morocc's
historian and find out what
you can about Satan Morocc,
Morocc, and Thanatos Tower.
We need to know how they're
linked to the missing kids.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想让你找到梦罗克的历史学家，
并尽可能多地了解魔王梦罗克、
梦罗克和达纳托斯塔。
我们需要知道他们与失踪儿童
之间有什么联系。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess since he hasn't
met me yet, maybe he'll
talk to me. Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想既然他还没见过我，
也许他会跟我说话。好吧，我会去做的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Great, thanks a lot.
Okay then, I'll see
you later. Remember,
the Morocc Inn, alright?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
太好了，非常感谢。
那么，回头见。
记住，是梦罗克旅馆，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
L-Lin...?
You there?

[Lin]
Yeah, I'm here.
So, were you able
to find that historian?
What exactly did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是的，我在。
那么，你找到那个历史学家了吗？
你具体学到了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was only able to
speak to the historian's
assistant. Let's see...
I found out about the
origin of this city's name...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我只能与历史学家的助手对话。
让我看看...
我了解了这座城市名称的起源...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanatos Tower was used
by Morocc Satan to summon
his own monsters into our
world. Now, it's being rebuilt,
even though it houses these
demons that look like angels...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
达纳托斯塔曾被魔王梦罗克用来
召唤他自己的魔物进入我们的世界。
现在，它正在被重建，
尽管它里面住着这些看起来像天使的恶魔...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Huh. That's strange.
I heard that those are
actually real angels that
are guarding the tower for
some reason. Hm. What else
did you manage to learn?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯。这很奇怪。
我听说那些实际上是真正的天使，
出于某种原因守护着这座塔。嗯。你还
学到了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, Satan Morocc, if it
exists, might be able to
come back into our world
if the seal is broken by
sacrificing children...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，魔王梦罗克，如果它存在的话，
可能会通过献祭儿童来打破封印，
从而回到我们的世界...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
That... That sounds
really bad, especially
with all of those children
missing from Morocc lately.
What'll be our next move?
I guess we'll talk to Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
那...那听起来真的很糟糕，尤其是
最近梦罗克有很多儿童失踪。
我们下一步该怎么做？
我想我们会和R先生谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
The way things are going,
he's probably gonna ask us
to investigate Thanatos Tower.
For now, we'll see what he wants. Ah, and not a word of anything
that we've discussed out here.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
按照目前的情况，
他可能会要求我们调查达纳托斯塔。
目前，我们先看看他想要什么。啊，还有，
不要把我们在这里讨论的任何事情说出去。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Report to me first.
Did you learn anything
about Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
先向我汇报。
你了解到关于达纳托斯塔的任何信息吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I found some old log
entries about Satan Morocc.
They pretty much confirm that
Satan Morocc is real, and that
it's sealed under Morocc Castle.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我找到了一些关于
魔王梦罗克的旧日志。
它们基本上证实了魔王梦罗克
是真实存在的，而且
它被封印在梦罗克城堡下方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Rekenber Corporation
is also responsible for the
tower's reconstruction, and
they ultimately plan to repair
all tweleve of its levels.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雷肯贝尔公司也负责中央塔的
重建工作，他们最终计划
修复塔的全部十二层。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Why would they want to do
something crazy like that?
If Mr. R is really preventing
Morocc Satan's return, then
his attackers must want
to revive Morocc Satan...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
他们为什么要做
这么疯狂的事？
如果R先生真的在阻止
魔王梦罗克的回归，
那么攻击他的人一定
是想复活魔王梦罗克...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
But if he's lying, and
he's trying to bring Morocc
Satan into our world, then
he's wanted by the Dandelion
group... meaning, he may be
the target for Kidd's mission.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
但如果他在撒谎，
试图把魔王梦罗克
带到我们的世界，
那么他就是蒲公英组织的
通缉犯...也就是说，
他可能是基德任务的目标。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Crap! This could be
really bad. I need to
talk about this to our
commanding officer Valdes
about this. While I do that,
you go and check on Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
糟了！
情况可能非常严重。
我需要和瓦尔德斯指挥官
谈谈这件事。在我去之前，
你去看看R先生的情况。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Why did Valdes accept
both of these missions?!
In the worst case scenario,
we might be the ones who'll
have to keep Satan Morocc
from returning to this world...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
瓦尔德斯为什么
接受了这两个任务？！
在最坏的情况下，
我们可能不得不阻止
魔王梦罗克回到这个世界...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a gleaming
crest that looks like a
splashing wave of water.^000000
^3355FFYou take out a Rough Wind
to counter the crest's power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一枚闪闪发光的
徽章，看起来像
飞溅的水波。^000000
^3355FF你拿出风灵原石
来抵消徽章的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a gleaming
crest that looks like a
splashing wave of water.^000000
^3355FFYou probably need a Rough
Wind to counter its power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一枚闪闪发光的
徽章，看起来像
飞溅的水波。^000000
^3355FF你可能需要风灵原石
来抵消它的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe crest responds to
the Rough Wind, and both

help you with whatever

scripts.translation:

希望我能为你提供

莫洛奇的历史
比大多数人想象的

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
When I get some time,
I really want to investigate
that Thanatos Tower. I get
the feeling that there's so
much I can learn there~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
等我有空的时候，
真的很想去调查一下
达纳托斯塔。
我感觉在那里
能学到很多东西~

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, we usually don't
have many visitors here.
Are you here to speak to
our local historian? He's
pretty busy right now, so
I hope you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，我们这里
通常很少有访客。
你是来和我们的
当地历史学家对话的吗？
他现在很忙，
希望你能稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Though, to be honest,
he's kind of hiding under
the covers at the moment.
Some Assassin came to
request some information,
but he scared him off...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
不过说实话，
他此刻正躲在被子里。
有个刺客来
请求获取一些信息，
但他把他吓跑了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
It was pretty funny, actually.
The guy walked in, flashed
his dagger, and declared that
he needed some important
information. I guess my boss
was pretty intimidated by him.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
其实还挺好笑的。
那个人走进来，亮出短剑，
声称需要一些重要的资讯。
我想我的老板被他吓到了。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
If it's really important,
then I might be able to
answer your questions if
they're about Morocc's most
ancient histories and legends.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
如果真的很重要，
只要问题涉及梦罗克
最古老的历史和传说，
我或许能回答你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ask Sephit about the
four elemental crests around
Morocc, their significance, and
about Raiyan Moore. You also
inform her that you've already
stabilized the crests' power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向塞菲特询问
梦罗克周围四枚元素纹章
及其意义，还有莱扬·摩尔。
你还告诉她，
你已经稳定了纹章的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Moore... Moore...
His work sounds really
important, so I'm surprised
I haven't heard of him. I'd ask
my boss, but I can't disturb
him right now. Ah, well...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
摩尔...摩尔...
他的工作听起来很重要，
所以我有点惊讶没听说过他。
我想问问老板，
但现在不能打扰他。啊，算了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, first of all, not too
many people know about
those crests. Still, you did
a great service by stabilizing
them. Otherwise, the seal under
Morocc Castle would break.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，首先，
知道那些纹章的人并不多。
不过，你稳定了它们，
真是帮了大忙。
否则，梦罗克城堡下方的
封印就会破裂。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
The seal beneath Morocc
Castle actually keeps Satan
Morocc from entering our world.
If he ever returned, he might
repeat the mass destruction
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
梦罗克城堡下方的封印
实际上是为了阻止魔王梦罗克
进入我们的世界。
如果他再次回来，
可能会重演大规模的破坏。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
When Satan Morocc
was terrorizing the human
world, he used Thanatos
Tower as his power base.
There, he would summon
countless hordes of minions.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
当魔王梦罗克
肆虐人间时，
他利用达纳托斯塔
作为他的据点。
在那里，他召唤出
无数的魔物大军。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
That tower has been in ruins
for years, but recently some
company started reconstructing
it, even though demons, well,
disguised as angels, still
roam that place freely.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
那座塔已经荒废多年，
但最近有家公司
开始重建它，
尽管恶魔们，呃，
伪装成天使，
仍然在那儿自由游荡。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Satan Morocc may have been
unimaginably powerful, but
it would take a lot of work
to bring him back into our
world. Let's see, you could
destroy Morocc's seal...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
魔王梦罗克可能强大得
超乎想象，
但要让他回到我们的世界，
需要付出巨大的努力。
让我想想，你可以
破坏梦罗克的封印...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
There was also... Oh, God.
Long ago, someone actually
sacrificed children in a failed
attempt to revive Morocc Satan.
The children missing here in
Morocc-- Y-you don't think...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
还有...哦，天哪。
很久以前，有人
为了复活魔王梦罗克
而献祭了儿童。
梦罗克失踪的儿童——
你...你不会觉得...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
But who really knows?
I mean we have historical
records of Satan Morocc, 
but maybe it's just a legend.
Aside from that, we have no
proof that he really exists.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
但谁知道呢？
毕竟我们有魔王梦罗克的
历史记录，
但也许那只是传说。
除此之外，
我们没有证据证明他真实存在。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
...Well, aside from those
elemental crests, I mean.
Then again, maybe they just
regulate this region's elements
to make it possible for people
to live here in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
...好吧，除了那些
元素纹章之外。
不过话说回来，
也许它们只是调节
这个地区的元素，
让人们能在沙漠中生存。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, we usually don't
have many visitors here.
Are you here to speak to
our local historian? He's
pretty busy right now, so
I hope you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，我们这里
通常很少有访客。
你是来和我们的
当地历史学家对话的吗？
他现在很忙，
希望你能稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Though, to be honest,
he's kind of hiding under
the covers at the moment.
Some Assassin came to
request some information,
but she scared him off...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
不过说实话，
他此刻正躲在被子里。
有个刺客来
请求获取一些资讯，
但他把他吓跑了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
If it's really important,
then I might be able to
answer your questions if
they're about Morocc's most
ancient histories and legends.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
如果真的很重要，
只要问题涉及梦罗克
最古老的历史和传说，
我或许能回答你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ask Sephit for any
information related to
Satan Morocc and Thanatos
Tower, particularly their
significance and how
they might be related.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向塞菲特询问
与魔王梦罗克和达纳托斯塔
相关的任何资讯，
特别是它们的意义
以及它们之间可能的联系。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou also inform her
about Moore's research,
and about the elemental
crests hidden throughout
Morocc that you've balanced.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你还告诉她
关于摩尔的研究，
以及你平衡了
隐藏在梦罗克各处的
元素纹章。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Moore... Moore...
His work sounds really
important, so I'm surprised
I haven't heard of him. I'd ask
my boss, but I can't disturb
him right now. Ah, well...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
摩尔...摩尔...
他的工作听起来很重要，
所以我有点惊讶没听说过他。
我想问问老板，
但现在不能打扰他。啊，算了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, first of all, not too
many people know about
those crests. Still, you did
a great service by stabilizing
them. Otherwise, the seal under
Morocc Castle would break.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，首先，
知道那些纹章的人并不多。
不过，你稳定了它们，
真是帮了大忙。
否则，梦罗克城堡下方的
封印就会破裂。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
The seal beneath Morocc
Castle actually keeps Satan
Morocc from entering our world.
If he ever returned, he might
repeat the mass destruction
that he caused in the past.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
梦罗克城堡下方的封印
实际上是为了阻止魔王梦罗克
进入我们的世界。
如果他再次回来，
可能会重演过去
造成的大规模破坏。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
It's funny that you should ask
about Thanatos Tower. When
Satan Morocc was terrorizing
our world, he used that place
to summon hordes of minions
that would menace us humans.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
你问到达纳托斯塔
真是巧了。当魔王梦罗克
肆虐我们的世界时，
他利用那个地方
召唤魔物大军
来威胁我们人类。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
That tower has been in ruins
for years, but recently some
company started reconstructing
it, even though demons, well,
disguised as angels, still
roam that place freely.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
那座塔已经荒废多年，
但最近有家公司
开始重建它，
尽管恶魔们，呃，
伪装成天使，
仍然在那儿自由游荡。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Satan Morocc may have been
unimaginably powerful, but
it would take a lot of work
to bring him back into our
world. Let's see, you could
destroy Morocc's seal...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
魔王梦罗克可能强大得
超乎想象，
但要让他回到我们的世界，
需要付出巨大的努力。
让我想想，你可以
破坏梦罗克的封印...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
There was also... Oh, God.
Long ago, someone actually
sacrificed children in a failed
attempt to revive Morocc Satan.
The children missing here in
Morocc-- Y-you don't think...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
还有...哦，天哪。
很久以前，有人
为了复活魔王梦罗克
而献祭了儿童。
梦罗克失踪的儿童——
你...你不会觉得...

scripts.text:

But who really knows?
I mean we have historical
records of Satan Morocc, 
but maybe it's just a legend.
Aside from that, we have no
proof that he really exists.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
但谁知道呢？
毕竟我们有魔王梦罗克的
历史记录，
但也许那只是传说。
除此之外，
我们没有证据证明他真实存在。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

元素纹章之外。
不过话说回来，
也许它们只是调节
这个地区的元素，

have many visitors here.
Are you here to speak to
our local historian? He's
pretty busy right now, so
I hope you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，我们这里
通常很少有访客。
你是来和我们的
当地历史学家对话的吗？
他现在很忙，
希望你能稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Lately, I've been
digging through some
old historical records and
learned something about
a monster called Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
最近，我翻阅了一些
古老的历史记录，
了解到了一个
名叫魔王梦罗克的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
According to the legends,
he's sealed beneath Morocc
Castle, and our town gets its
name from him. That sounds
pretty grotesque, don't you
think? Too weird to be true...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
根据传说，
他被封印在梦罗克城堡下方，
我们的城镇
就是以他命名的。
听起来挺可怕的，
你觉得呢？太离奇了，
不像是真的...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
That's grave news...
I had my suspicions
about Mr. R, but I never
thought he was capable
of such audacity...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
真是严重的消息...
我对R先生有所怀疑，
但没想到他竟敢如此大胆...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it! I know you had
to accept both Mr. R and
the Dandelion Organization
because we didn't know the
truth beforehand, but does
Lin know about this now?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
该死！我知道你不得不同时接受R先生和蒲公英组织，
因为我们事先并不知道真相，
但现在琳知道这件事了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I doubt it. I only learned
that Mr. R was the true
kidnapper when you told
me just now. But to sacrifice
them in order to revive Satan
Morocc... That's beyond evil.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我想不会。直到你刚才告诉我，
我才得知R先生才是真正的绑架者。
但为了复活魔王梦罗克而牺牲他们...
这简直邪恶至极。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Mr. R... If he is Raiyan
Moore, then you can find him
in the other room. Go and
interrogate him, confirm
everything you have learned.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
R先生...如果他就是莱恩·摩尔，
那么你可以在隔壁房间找到他。
去审问他，确认你所知道的一切。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Come...
This way.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
来...
这边请。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
This is getting
too serious. Valdes,
wait, I'm coming with you!
{0}, come on, quickly!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
情况越来越严重了。瓦尔德斯，
等等，我和你一起去！
{0}，快跟上！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Master, did you know
from the beginning?!
You knew that the person
I was supposed to protect
is the same person that
Kidd is supposed to find?!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
师父，你一开始就知道了吗？！
你早就知道我要保护的人，
就是基德要寻找的那个人？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Lin, calm down. Yes,
I suspected as such from
the start. However, I did
know whether to trust Mr. R
or the Dandelion organization.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
琳，冷静点。是的，
我一开始就有所怀疑。但是，
我并不知道该信任R先生
还是蒲公英组织。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Since both parties claimed
to be able to help the missing
children, I took the chance.
For now, the best thing to
do would be to ask if Mr. R's
attackers are from Dandelion...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
既然双方都声称能帮到失踪的儿童，
我就赌了一把。
眼下最好的办法，
就是问问袭击R先生的人是否来自蒲公英...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright... I can't believe
it... Mr. R. Moore... Kidd
is supposed to hunt down
Raiyan Moore... It's too
much of a coincidence...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧...我简直不敢相信...
R. 摩尔...基德本该追捕莱恩·摩尔...
这也太巧了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lin! I'm sorry to
interrupt, but Mr. R
is missing... I don't
know where he is!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
琳！抱歉打扰一下，
但R先生不见了...我不知道他在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What?! What do yo--
Wh-what's going on?!
What's this noise in
my f-freakin' head?!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什么？！你刚说什--
发...发生什么事了？！
我头...我脑子里这是什么声音？！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh no...
This is what
I feared the most...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
糟糕...
这正是我最害怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's...
What's going on?

[Lin]
I think...
I think it's the
ceremony to revive
Satan Morocc! Mr. R must
have went there to stop
them... or to join them!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想...
我想那是复活魔王梦罗克的仪式！
R先生一定是去阻止他们了...
或者是去加入他们了！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Lin, go call everyone
in the guild! And you,
try to find the source
of that weird echo!
Hurry, there's no time!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
琳，去叫公会里的所有人！
还有你，
试着找出那奇怪回声的来源！
快一点，没时间了！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
遵命，师父！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
No matter what the 
cost, we can't let
that ritual finish...!
If Satan Morocc really
exists, we can't let
him enter our world!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
无论付出什么代价，
我们都不能让那个仪式完成...！
如果魔王梦罗克真的存在，
我们不能让他进入我们的世界！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?! That sounds
like Lin's voice...
Where are they?
Where have they gone?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？！那听起来
像是琳的声音...
他们在哪里？
他们去了哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Raiyan Moore...!
Wh-where is he?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
莱恩·摩尔...！
他...他在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
What the deuce?
He should be just
in this room. Wait,
how could he get past
our security magic...?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
该死？
他应该就在这间房间里。等等，
他是怎么绕过我们的防护魔法的...？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Where's Lin?
Lin?! Lin, where
are you? Answer me!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳在哪里？
琳？！琳，你在哪？回答我！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
God! Wh-what's
that--where is that
voice coming from?!
My head feels like
it's gonna split open!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
天哪！那...那是什么——
那个声音是从哪里传来的？！
我的头感觉快要炸开了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn, that has to be him!
He's trying to revive Satan
Morocc right now! And where's
Lin?! What happened to her?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
该死，那一定是他！
他正在试图复活魔王梦罗克！琳呢？！
她怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
{0}, I'm going
to call every member of the
Assassin Guild. You and Kidd
go try to find the source of
that voice and stop this!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
{0}，我要去召集刺客公会的所有成员。
你和基德去找那个声音的来源，阻止这一切！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
遵命，师父！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I only hope that
we're not too late
to stop this from
happening. Hurry,
the fate of the world
hangs in the balance!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我只希望我们来得及阻止这一切。
快一点，世界的命运悬于一线！

scripts.text:

of a dead man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一具死去的男子的尸体。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying
on the floor. He seems
very close to dying, and
is mumbling deliriously.^000000
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
What is this place?
Arrgh, my head hurts,
but I've got to stop
Satan Morocc's revival...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里...？
这是什么地方？
啊，头好痛，
但我必须阻止魔王梦罗克的复活...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's that voice
again! Kidd? Valdes?
Are any of you here?
Damn, I must be all alone.
I guess I have to stop this
weird ritual all by myself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是那个声音！基德？瓦尔德斯？
你们在这里吗？
该死，我一定是孤身一人。
看来我得独自阻止这个奇怪的仪式了！

scripts.text:
[?????]
...Isn't the moon
so beautiful tonight?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...今晚的月亮真美啊？

scripts.text:
[?????]
...But I wonder...
Why are there twice as many
guards when the moon is full?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...不过我想知道...
为什么满月的时候，卫兵的数量会多一倍？

scripts.text:
[???????]
The moon is so red...
Yes, it's been a year...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
月亮好红...
是的，已经一年了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's going on?
Who's there? Kidd?
Valdes? Anybody?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
发生什么事了？
谁在那里？基德？
瓦尔德斯？有人吗？
刚才那是什么声音？

scripts.text:
[?????]
So, you telling me you
don't know how this town
got its name? Well, it's
kind of a scary tale...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
这么说，你不知道
这座城镇名字的由来？
嗯，这其实是个
有点可怕的故事...

scripts.text:
[?????]
An evil demon invaded our
world, summoning troops of
his minions from the darkness.
However, he was defeated and
sealed beneath this castle
by a legendary hero.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
一个邪恶的恶魔入侵了
我们的世界，从黑暗中
召唤出他的爪牙大军。
然而，他被一位传奇英雄
击败，并封印在这座城堡之下。

scripts.text:
[???????]
But the hatred of Satan
Morocc has not ebbed with
time. If you look at the full
moon from here, it is colored
red with Satan Morocc's rage...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
但魔王梦罗克的仇恨
并没有随时间消退。
如果你从这里看满月，
会发现它被魔王梦罗克的
怒火染成了红色...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I keep hearing
things! Where the hell
is it all coming from?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我不断听到
声音！这该死的
声音到底是从哪里来的？！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hmpf.
It has begun.

[?????]
That smoke...?
What exactly is going
on over there every
full moon?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
那烟雾...？
每到满月，那边到底
在发生什么事？

scripts.text:
[???????]
Well...
Who's to say?

[{0}]
These voices...
They're like past
memories of something
that's happened here
in Castle Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这些声音...
它们像是这里发生过的
某些事情的
过去记忆...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sir, our investigation has
turned something up. Every
15 days, a carriage secretly
transports about 20 to 30
children into the castle.
However, they never come out...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
大人，我们的调查
有了发现。每隔15天，
就有马车秘密运送
20到30名儿童进入城堡。
然而，他们从未出来过...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Are you serious...?
What the hell could
they be doing in there?!
Come on, let's go...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
你是认真的...？
他们到底在里面做什么？！
快，我们走...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Wh-what's with
all of this noise?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
这...这些噪音
是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sorry, m'lord.
It's nothing, but
we'll take care of
it as soon as possible.
Shut up, children. Silence!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
抱歉，大人。
没什么大事，
我们会尽快处理。
闭嘴，孩子们。安静！

scripts.text:
[???????]
This place is so hot...
Where's my daddy? I don't...
I don't wanna go to Thanatos...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
这里好热...
爸爸在哪里？我不想...
我不想去塔纳托斯...

scripts.text:
[??????]
Make sure that
nothing interferes
with our plan. Nothing...
